He attended the session with Basil Joseph. “So, War 2 is a whole different conversation for me, because while it is a number two of a franchise, it was not a movie that I had written, and it was a different experience,” he shared.

title: Sanjay Dutt’s The Glenwalk launches new digital campaign for Dominance Reserve featuring Sunny Leone and Tanuj Virwani
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The campaign highlights the brand’s 48% alcohol-by-volume expression, with the 750 ml bottle priced at Rs 1,698 in Maharashtra. The company has also revealed plans to introduce a 200 ml pack in the state at Rs 555. The smaller format is expected to expand the product’s availability to consumers looking for a lower-priced pack.

Adding to this, Speaking about the campaign, Sanjay Dutt, co-founder of The Glenwalk, shared, “The Glenwalk represents a bold attitude and a distinctive identity. The 48% ABV Dominance Reserve reflects that spirit, and the campaign captures the attitude and character that we want the brand to stand for. It is exciting to see this proposition come alive through a creative campaign that brings together a strong concept and an engaging narrative.”

Meanwhile, Mokksh Sani, founder of Living Liquidz and co-founder of Cartel Bros, shared the product was developed with changing consumer preferences in mind. “The Indian whisky consumer is evolving, with a growing appreciation for bold, distinctive expressions that deliver a stronger experience. At The Glenwalk, we recognised this shift and wanted to create a Scotch whisky that truly resonates with the Indian palate. With India’s first 48% ABV Scotch whisky, we bring together the authenticity of Scottish craftsmanship and a higher strength that gives the expression its unmistakably kadak character. For us, it is about understanding what today’s Indian consumer is looking for and delivering a whisky that stands apart in both character and strength.”

Notably, The company has also cited recent recognition at the Spirits Selection by Concours Mondial de Bruxelles 2026 in Madeira, Portugal. According to the brand, The Glenwalk Blended 48%, 7 Years received a Grand Gold medal, while its 5-year expression won a Silver medal.

As per the latest buzz, The Glenwalk is marketed by Cartel Bros, which describes the whisky as Scottish-made. The brand also claims the No. 1 position in Maharashtra’s Scotch category. These market rankings and product distinctions are based on information shared by the company.

title: Often praised for her looks, Tamannaah Bhatia questions what beauty truly means
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Tamannaah Bhatia has received praise for her beauty and colour, sometimes in a misogynistic manner. more Tamannaah Bhatia questions the meaning of beauty Tamannaah asked Sadhguru whether beauty is inherited or created. She asked, “I bump into people, and they look at me, and they think I am beautiful. How we end up looking by the end of our lives, is that something that has been given to us or something that we are creating?”

Adding to this, “About the genetic advantage that somebody may have of whatever kind of nose or chin or whatever you have, that does not entirely decide,” answered Sadhguru, adding, “It decides some aspects of it, but the rest of it is how an individual makes them, himself or herself. Because you may have whatever kind of nose or chin, but if you look at this, a joyful face is always a beautiful face. Isn’t it? That all of us can do. See, even I managed with all this (points to his long beard).”
Meanwhile, Tamannaah insisted that Sadhguru was beautiful, making him laugh.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sadhguru (@sadhguru)

As per the latest buzz, While promoting her movie 2025 movie Odela 2 in which she played a sadhvi, Tamannaah responded to a reporter’s question about being a ‘milky beauty’. “You are saying milky beauty, but why did you look at a milky beauty and think that she can't be a Shiva Shakti? Your question contains the answer. He [director Ashok Teja] does not look at milky beauty as something to be ashamed of or feel bad about” She also shared that glamour in women must be celebrated, adding, “If we look at ourselves in a certain way, then nobody can respect us.”

In further updates, In April, she addressed a question of whether being known for her looks has been limiting as an star. She shared, “I just do not like being in victim mode and saying I am not getting opportunities because I am so beautiful and all that. That just sounds very strange to me.” In October last year, Annu Kapoor referred to her ‘dudhiya badan’ (fair and beautiful body) while talking about her song Aaj Ki Raat on Shubhankar Mishra's YouTube channel. He received massive backlash for his comment.

On top of that, Speaking at NDTV Profit Ignite later that month, Tamannaah addressed sexist remarks about her looks and shared, “I think that as a creative person, our most important task is to listen. And when we listen, what we keep and what we filter is very important to understand. And because you are also a woman, you can understand that if we start giving importance to such things, then perhaps we will not be able to move forward in life.”
Tamannaah last starred in The Vvaan : Force of the Forrest. She has Ragini 3, Rangers, Purushan, IPS Maria and V Shantaram lined up.

title: Kaali Kheti review: Jackie Shroff, Sharad Kelkar's horror drama delivers unconventional scares, albeit in bits
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Jackie Shroff and Sharad Kelkar in a still from Kaali Kheti. more Kaali Kheti story Directed by Haris Imtiyaz Khan, the story revolves around Babuji ( Jackie Shroff ), who returns to his village after a decade. His son ( Sharad Kelkar ), a farmer like his father, is struggling to get a decent yield from his land. Babuji promises to help him turn things around. Meanwhile, he encounters an old friend who has lost his mental balance, with his body gradually turning black. The man soon dies, and Babuji begins experiencing similar symptoms. His quest to uncover the mystery behind the bizarre phenomenon forms the rest of the story.

Adding to this, The subject is unique, and the movie attempts to weave horror with a commentary on the plight of farmers, who continue to struggle to make ends meet. The rural setting lends the narrative an unsettling quality, while the idea of something sinister lurking beneath the very land that sustains these families makes for an interesting premise.

Meanwhile, The pacing is largely on point, and the movie deserves credit for not resorting to the usual horror movie tropes. It attempts to build an atmosphere of dread rather than solely relying on jump scares.

Notably, However, the writing, especially in the climax, doesn't do justice to the premise. The movie gets caught up in its central idea and leaves the viewer underwhelmed when it should ideally have been exhilarating.

As per the latest buzz, Among the performances, Jackie Shroff nails the part as the man connected to his roots. His real-life persona, as a nature lover, helps the story immensely. Sharad Kelkar as his son, who is hiding a dark secret, does justice. Neha Sargam as Radha is also effective.
In further updates, The special effects are also okay and serviceable.

On top of that, Overall, Kaali Kheti has an intriguing idea at its core. The rural setting and the connection between the land and the people who depend on it give the movie a distinct identity. The performances, particularly Shroff's, lend the story emotional weight. However, a promising premise can only take a movie so far, and the writing ultimately struggles to deliver a payoff that matches the mystery it builds. The result is moments of unease, but never quite as haunting as it could have been.

Rishabh Suri is an Assistant Editor, movie critic, and professional overthinker of plot points. When he isn’t writing against a deadline, he is usually sitting in a dark theater, compulsively memorising dialogues. For Rishabh, analysing movies isn't just a day job- it’s a habit he couldn't turn off even if he tried.

title: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana impresses cardinal Peter Turkson, he praises film's themes of good vs evil
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Vatican cardinal praises Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana after Rome screening, draws parallels with Biblical stories more The screening took place at the Pontifical Academies and was attended by staff members of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences, Ghana's Ambassador to the Holy See and embassy officials, an architect and other invited guests. After watching the movie, Cardinal Turkson, who is the Chancellor of the Pontifical Academies of Sciences and Social Sciences, shared his thoughts on its story, visuals and cultural significance.

Adding to this, The video was shared by official team of Ramayana on social media. Cardinal Peter spoke about how the movie's story begins with a conflict between good and evil, a theme he shared could also be found in ancient Babylonian accounts of creation. Drawing a comparison between the different traditions, he shared, "The whole story begins as if creation of earth is born out of a conflict between good and evil. Ancient Babylonian history also talks about the earth and having been created by a conflict between deities. So the mythical origins and background is very shared," he shared.

Meanwhile, He also brought up the relationship between Lord Rama and Lakshman, particularly the younger brother's decision to stand by and protect Rama. Turkson shared the bond reminded him of similar themes in the Bible. “A brother is supposed to keep a brother. This is a theme which is also shared, for example, in the Bible. Therefore, the brother of Rama does not feel like abandoning him, but protecting him and even protecting what belongs to him, which is his wife,” he observed.

Notably, The cardinal also had words of appreciation for the movie's visual scale and the work involved in creating its elaborate imagery. Referring to the way the movie depicts the forces of good and evil, he shared, “A lot of killing and destruction inside there, symbolised by certain figures which represent the evil. Then you have the other part which represents the good. The photography was very complex and the images presented there also very complex. So it required a lot of skill to put all of it together,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, According to trade tracker Sacnilk, the movie has collected around ₹ 1,693.50 crore rupees worldwide in 18 days, while its India net collection stands at ₹ 942.75 crore rupees. It also crossed the $100 million mark globally in its first week, with the Diwali holiday period giving its collections a significant boost.

In further updates, The movie features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Goddess Sita, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman and Yash as Ravana. Arun Govil plays Dashrath, Lara Dutta appears as Queen Kaikeyi and Rakul Preet Singh portrays Supranakha. The movie is produced by Namit Malhotra, with A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer composing the music.
On top of that, Ramayana: Rise of a Legend rolled out in theatres on November 5, 2026. The second is scheduled for 2028 rollout.

title: Ranveer Singh hyped Deepika Padukone up during Tu Mil Jaaye shoot, made dance rehearsals fun, say King choreographers
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranveer Singh accompanied Deepika Padukone on King set. more Piyush Bhagat and Shazia Samji recalls Ranveer Singh making King set fun In an interview with News18, Piyush and Shazia recalled shooting Tu Mil Jaaye in Cape Town. At the time, Deepika was pregnant with her second child. Ranveer accompanied her during the shoot. Recalling his presence on set, Shazia shared, "Ranveer was on set for a few days. He’s a sweetheart. He has been kind to us since day one. We’re manifesting a song with him now. But yes, it was super fun having all these great actors on set together. You can imagine the kind of energy we had around us! We got to see a lot of love and support between the husband-wife duo. Each time Deepika was performing, Ranveer was hyping her up. And his energy is infectious."

Adding to this, Piyush added, "He was fully enjoying the shoot. There was a lot of fun and mischief on set. We would all tell Ranveer, ‘Why don't you do a shot as well?’. It was like a family get-together. In fact, Ranveer was there even when Shah Rukh sir and Deepika were rehearsing for the song. Ranveer made it fun, happy and light for everyone."

Meanwhile, Piyush and Shazia also revealed how Deepika guided them while they choreographed Shah Rukh Khan, as it was their first time working with the superstar. The choreographers further lauded Deepika for shooting the song in summer clothes despite the cold weather, while the rest of the crew wore multiple layers.

Notably, Tu Mil Jaaye is the first track from King and offers a glimpse of Shah Rukh and Deepika's chemistry. The song features vocals by Arijit Singh, Ed Sheeran and Madhubanti, lyrics by Kumaar, and music composed by Sachin-Jigar.

As per the latest buzz, Actors Deepika and Ranveer fell in love on the sets of Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela in 2013. After dating for several years, the couple tied the knot in a wedding ceremony at Lake Como, Italy, in November 2018, following both Konkani and Sindhi traditions. They welcomed their first child, a daughter named Dua Padukone Singh, on September 8, 2024. In September 2026, the couple became parents for the second time, welcoming another daughter, whom they named Devi Padukone Singh.

In further updates, Helmed by Siddharth Anand, the action drama stars Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan and Suhana Khan in lead roles. title: Rakesh Bedi says Ek Duuje Ke Liye was a bigger hit than Dhurandhar, recalls getting death threat over his villainous role
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Rakesh Bedi compares Dhurandhar and Ek Duuje Ke Liye's success. more Rakesh Bedi says Ek Duuje Ke Liye was a bigger hit than Dhurandhar On November 21, Dhurandhar was screened at the 57th International Movie Festival of India (IFFI). Rakesh attended the screening and inaugurated the Indian Panorama section. After the screening, the star sat down for a press conference, where he spoke about the movie's success. He recalled experiencing several successes before the 2025 movie, including Ek Duuje Ke Liye. Despite the absence of social media, the movie continued to run in different cities across India for four to five years, with audiences deeply invested in its characters.
Adding to this, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Diehard Kamalians (@diehard.kamalians)

Meanwhile, He shared, "I was a part of Ek Duuje Ke Liye, which today’s generation cannot imagine the success it had. It was a bigger hit than Dhurandhar. However, Dhurandhar is also big because of social media. Today, one button can take you around the world in 1 second. But at that time, social media was not there. In that movie, I was a comic kind of villain; the hero and the heroine die because of me. As a result, I used to get death threats in the form of letters. Phone toh tab tha nahin. Toh letters aate the that ‘Aapko maar daalenge. Aapki wajah se yeh log mar gaye (There were no phones back then, so I would receive letters saying, ‘We will kill you. These people died because of you)’!"

Notably, He added, "So, I have seen such reactions as well. Then, my TV show Yeh Jo Hai Zindagi was also a big success. But those successes were limited (due to no social media at that time). Dhurandhar’s success, meanwhile, is very different. I have never tasted this volume of success in the last 10-15 years. I have had hits but not such a big hit. I don’t think anybody has had a hit like Dhurandhar (laughs). It’s absolutely unparalleled. A lot of cinema pundits are now dividing Indian cinema into three major milestones – Mughal-E-Azam (1960), Sholay (1975) and Dhurandhar."

As per the latest buzz, K Balachander’s Ek Duuje Ke Liye (1981) is a romantic tragedy that marked Kamal Haasan’s Hindi movie debut and introduced Rati Agnihotri to Hindi cinema. Rakesh played Chakravarty, popularly known as Chakram, in the romantic drama. He portrayed a comic yet villainous character who is brought in by Sapna's (Rati Agnihotri) mother to woo her and help her forget Vasu (Kamal Haasan). However, Chakram himself falls in love with Sapna and becomes a source of misunderstanding between the two lovers. He eventually tricks Vasu into believing that Sapna is marrying him. The movie emerged as a major box-office success and became one of the highest-grossing films of that year.

In further updates, Helmed by Aditya Dhar, Dhurandhar is the first instalment of the two-part movie, rolled out in 2025. The movie featured Ranveer Singh, Akshaye Khanna, Sanjay Dutt, Arjun Rampal, R Madhavan and Sara Arjun, among others, in key roles. It received a positive critical response and broke several box-office records. The movie collected over ₹ 1,300 crore rupees worldwide despite being banned in Gulf countries. The second part, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, collected over ₹ 1,800 crore rupees worldwide and set a record by becoming the first Indian movie to surpass the ₹ 1,000 crore rupees mark at the domestic ticket-window.

title: REVEALED: Jio Studios backs Jaideep Ahlawat-Shefali Shah starrer Hisaab; 25 years after Aankhen, Vipul Shah promises a NEVER-BEFORE-SEEN bank heist drama in Indian cinema
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

As per the website of the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC), Hisaab was passed with a U/A 13+ certificate last year. Interestingly, Vipul Shah's Sunshine Pictures Ltd and Jio Studios are both mentioned as producers of the movie.

Adding to this, With Hisaab , Vipul Shah returns to the bank heist genre 25 years after delivering the much-loved Aankhen (2002), which starred Amitabh Bachchan, Akshay Kumar, Arjun Rampal, Paresh Rawal and Sushmita Sen.

Meanwhile, In an interview with Mid-Day in February this year, Vipul Shah opened up that Hisaab is a movie about a bank robbery “with a twist”. He shared, “After Aankhen , I always wanted to make another movie on a bank heist, but I was not getting the right idea. Hisaab is as unique a story as Aankhen was – a kind of heist movie that India has not seen before. It’s taken us a long time to write it. Comparisons with Aankhen are unavoidable, though there is nothing common between the two films [except] the bank robbery. So, we wanted to make something that had strong content.”

Notably, Hisaab will also mark the second instance of Jaideep Ahlawat and Shefali Shah featuring in the same movie after the much loved Three Of Us (2023). Meanwhile, in an interesting coincidence, Jio Studios now has two films featuring the word ‘Hisaab’ in their titles – Hisaab and Hisaab Barabar . The latter starred R Madhavan, Neil Nitin Mukesh and Kirti Kulhari and was rolled out directly on Zee 5 in January 2025.

title: Ramayana worldwide box office collection: Resurgent Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film crosses ₹1700 crore; beats Baahubali 2, Dhurandhar 2's all-time records
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravie Dubey. more Ramayana worldwide ticket-window update The Ranbir Kapoor and Yash -starrer had seven consecutive days when it grossed over ₹ 100 crore rupees worldwide. But this followed a lukewarm second week, during which daily collections fell below ₹ 30 crore rupees. On Saturday, the Ramayana bounced back with a 70% jump at the domestic ticket-window. On Sunday, its 18th day in theatres, the movie saw another big jump in collections, bringing in ₹ 35 crore rupees net. This is the second biggest third Sunday for an Indian movie. Ramayana’s domestic earnings now stand at ₹ 942 crore rupees net ( ₹ 1126 crore rupees gross). It is on its way to becoming the second Hindi movie ever to cross ₹ 1000 crore rupees domestically, after Dhurandhar: The Revenge, which achieved this milestone earlier this year.

Adding to this, Overseas, Ramayana turned over a new leaf after a subpar start, and then fell again, only to have a second resurgence in its third weekend. Thanks to a solid showing in the US and in niche markets like Thailand, Vietnam, and Nepal, Ramayana actually maintained its overseas run in its third weekend. After a spate of sub-$1 million days, Ramayana bounced back to bring in over $5 million in its third weekend. This was enough to take its overseas gross to $63 million. As a result, Ramayana has now collected ₹ 1718 crore rupees worldwide after 18 days. It is the fastest Indian movie to the ₹ 1700-crore rupees mark, beating Dhurandhar 2’s record of 24 days.

Meanwhile, Becoming the fastest to ₹ 1700 crore rupees isn’t the only record Ramayana has set this Sunday. With its overseas haul this weekend, the movie has also become the highest-grossing Indian movie overseas without a boost from China. The four highest-grossing Indian films overseas have all seen huge contributions from China and Russia. Dangal collected $230 million in China while Secret Superstar collected over $100 million there. Bajrangi Bhaijaan accounted for $48 million of its $82 million overseas haul from China. Similarly, Disco Dancer had almost all of its $76 million in overseas gross from Russia.

Notably, Among films with no massive single-country contribution, SS Rajamouli’s Baahubali 2 was the leading earner. The movie had held the top spot for over ten years with a $61-million overseas gross. Ramayana beat that by crossing $63 million on Sunday. It had already surpassed the overseas hauls of other global Indian hits, such as Dhurandhar 2 ($51 million), Pathaan ($49 million), and RRR ($40 million).

As per the latest buzz, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is the first of a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The first part is running in theatres, while the second part is set for a Diwali 2028 rollout.

title: Deepika Padukone was frustrated and almost in tears while doing maid act in acting class, recalls tutor Anupam Kher
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Anupam Kher recalls teaching Deepika Padukone the importance of conviction. more Anupam Kher recalls Deepika Padukone's acting school days During the session, Anupam emphasised the importance of practising the craft of acting and cited Deepika's experience as an example. He shared, "Deepika Padukone was our student in the second batch. She was a well-known model. Farah decided to cast her in the movie with Shah Rukh Khan. It was a 3-month course. Because Deepika was a model and came from a very educated background, she was very prim and proper. She would do everything properly. She used to pick up the cup of tea with that style. Sometimes, there was no believability."
Adding to this, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Kevin D'mello Star (@kevin.dmello1911)

Meanwhile, Anupam recalled asking Deepika to play a maid who had to simply sweep the floor during one of his classes. He shared she performed the task with charm. He then asked his domestic help to do the same, noting that she swept the floor with complete conviction. He added, "I told Deepika that we would be doing this exercise till I believe you are actually doing it. She was frustrated initially, and almost had tears in her eyes. But, she did it and she thanked me. You have to do it. You have to constantly practice, and yet be street smart to get work."

Notably, Before entering the movie industry, Deepika worked as a model and made her acting debut in the Kannada movie Aishwarya in 2006. In 2007, she got her big breakthrough when Farah Khan launched her in Bollywood with Om Shanti Om. Her portrayal of Shantipriya and Sandy collected her widespread recognition and established her as one of Bollywood's most promising newcomers.
As per the latest buzz, She went on to feature in films such as Bachna Ae Haseeno, Love Aaj Kal and Housefull before delivering a career-defining performance in Imtiaz Ali's Cocktail (2012).

In further updates, The following year, she delivered a string of successful films, including Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani, Chennai Express and Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela, among others. Deepika made her Hollywood debut opposite Vin Diesel in xXx: Return of Xander Cage in 2017. In 2023, she featured in back-to-back blockbusters Pathaan and Jawan, followed by Fighter, Kalki 2898 AD and Singham Again in 2024.

title: Namit Malhotra compares Lord Hanuman to Iron Man, says ‘superhero’ Sunny Deol is perfect to play the part in Ramayana
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Namit Malhotra reveals why Sunny Deol is best suited to play Lord Hanuman in Ramayana. more Namit Malhotra compares Lord Hanuman to Iron Man In an interview with Gold Derby, Namit Malhotra spoke about Lord Hanuman being India's answer to Iron Man. Calling him one of the most beloved characters in the Ramayana, he shared, "Imagine him as our Iron Man, because he's the fan favourite. The next movie will really be elevated because we have Hanuman; it's a roller-coaster waiting to happen. And it's good to have preserved that introduction, because we left the audience with this sense of suspense over what Rama will do next. And now you'll see who is going to lead the charge."

Adding to this, The movie's producer explained that Sunny Deol was chosen to play Lord Hanuman because the character required a combination of innocence and likeability, along with the ability to evoke fear when angered. He felt Sunny, who enjoys a similar image in the country, was best suited to do justice to the immortal character.

Meanwhile, Namit added, “Sunny has done a couple of films where he's gone from being sweet and innocent to making mountains shake. He's already celebrated as one of India's superheroes without ever actually playing a superhero as such. The next part of the story goes into a whole new orbit in terms of the scale of the storytelling, so it will be great to have Hanuman in there alongside Rama. In some ways, the epic of the Ramayana really begins here.”

Notably, The post-credits scene of Ramayana introduced Hanuman against a powerful musical score. While his face remained hidden, a wider shot showed him flying with his gada and chanting Jai Shri Ram. The Hanuman Chalisa, sung by Diljit Dosanjh, played in the background. Hanuman's arrival sets the stage for the 2028 sequel, where he will play a crucial role in Rama's search for Sita and the battle against Ravana.

title: AR Rahman says he turned down 10-12 films, big filmmakers for Ramayana, spent 3 years on film's score
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

AR Rahman reveals giving up projects for Ramayana. (Photo by FleckMedia) more AR Rahman reveals turning down projects for Ramayana Speaking about his experience of composing music for Ramayana at the International Movie Festival of India (IFFI) on Sunday, AR Rahman opened up about the lengthy creative process and shared, “We've been doing ‘Ramayana’ music for three years, the themes and everything. And some of them have, like, 12-13 versions. The Ravana Tandav actually had 12-13 versions, and then we finally found a version which everybody liked.”

Adding to this, He also spoke about turning down several projects to focus on Ramayana and shared, “The process was beautiful. Because of Ramayana, I left almost 10-12 movies, just to be in the zone. Many, many important big filmmakers I left. And I’m proud of it. I think I enjoy it. I only accept when I really love a project, and I enjoy it; it nourishes my artistic sense, and my whole team gets excited.”

Meanwhile, The soundtrack of Ramayana: Part 1 features tracks such as Jai Jai Ram, sung by Arijit Singh and Shreya Ghoshal; Ravana Tandav, featuring Vishal Dadlani's vocals; and Sita's Aspiration, featuring A.R. Ameen, Vaishali Samant, Rakshita Suresh and Antra Nandy. The lyrics have been penned by poet Kumar Vishwas. The album also includes an orchestral version of Jai Jai Ram and a Rama Theme, jointly composed by Rahman and Zimmer.

Notably, However, the movie's music has also faced considerable criticism since the rollout of its songs. Several listeners have questioned whether Rahman and Zimmer's compositions have lived up to the expectations surrounding the ambitious project. Ravana Tandav became a subject of debate, with some social media users criticising the track for lacking the intensity and traditional sound they expected for Ravana's character. body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana has surpassed ₹920 crore rupees mark in 19 days in theatres. more Ramayana ticket-window earnings According to trade tracker Sacnilk, by day 18, Ramayana collected ₹ 35.60 crore rupees net in India across 16,270 shows. The Hindi version contributed ₹ 26.25 crore rupees from 13,850 shows, while the Malayalam version collected ₹ 3.40 crore rupees from 869 shows, and the Kannada version collected ₹ 2.50 crore rupees from 449 shows. Tamil collections stood at ₹ 2.40 crore rupees across 645 shows, with the Telugu version adding ₹ 1.05 from 457 shows. The movie's net collection stands at ₹ 942.75 crore rupees.

Adding to this, Advance bookings for Ramayana began on Dussehra, 15 days ahead of its theatrical rollout. By the time the movie arrived in cinemas, it had already sold tickets worth ₹ 200 crore rupees worldwide. It opened with ₹ 64.85 crore rupees in India, giving it the fourth-biggest opening in Bollywood history. The movie continued its strong run over the next two days, collecting ₹ 107 crore rupees net on Monday and ₹ 94 crore rupees net on Tuesday, setting new records for the highest single-day collections in Indian cinema. By the end of its first week, Ramayana had crossed the ₹ 500-crore rupees mark.

Meanwhile, Nitesh Tiwari's two-part adaptation of Ramayana is among the biggest Indian movie projects, with Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Yash leading the cast. The first installment, Ramayana: Part 1, also called Ramayana: Rise of a Legend internationally, arrived in theatres on November 5, 2026. The makers also verified towards the end of the movie that Ramayana: Part 2, which was earlier expected to rollout in 2027, will now reach in Diwali 2028.

Notably, Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, while Sai Pallavi takes on the role of Goddess Sita. Yash appears as Ravana, with Ravie Dubey portraying Lakshman. title: EXCLUSIVE: IMPPA denies legal setback in Nikhil Dwivedi’s Saffron Magicworks dispute, clarifies Bombay High Court order was passed by consent
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The association says the October 23 ruling did not examine the merits of the commercial dispute or make any adverse observations against its Dispute Resolution Committee.

Adding to this, The clarification follows a social media post shared by Naik Naik & Company around October 30, titled “Bombay High Court Sets Aside IMPPA's Award Against Nikhil Dwivedi's Saffron Magicworks”. The post was subsequently amplified by an entertainment news handle. A report published in Complete Cinema, in its October 24 and 31, 2026 issue, also described the development as the quashing of an arbitration award, suggesting that IMPPA’s claims had been invalidated and that the association had been restricted from making public statements or declaring Saffron Magicworks a financial defaulter.

Meanwhile, Disputing these interpretations, IMPPA clarified that the July 3, 2026 award passed by its Dispute Resolution Committee was set aside by mutual consent and not on the basis of a judicial examination of its merits. According to the association, during the hearing before Justice Arif S. Doctor, counsel for Andolan Films, the original complainant before IMPPA’s committee, consented to setting aside the award while keeping all legal rights open. Saffron Magicworks accepted the proposal, following which the court set aside the award by consent and disposed of the suit, expressly preserving the rights, contentions and remedies of the parties.

Notably, IMPPA further shared that the High Court did not adjudicate upon the merits of the underlying commercial dispute or make any findings concerning the jurisdiction, competence or procedure of its Dispute Resolution Committee. It also maintained that the court made no adverse observations or directions against the association.

As per the latest buzz, The association has additionally denied that the October 23 order places any permanent restraint on it from issuing statements concerning Saffron Magicworks. It clarified that IMPPA has no independent monetary claim against the production house, as the original claim belonged solely to Andolan Films, which remains free to pursue its remedies before an appropriate forum. Therefore, the order cannot be interpreted as an exoneration of Saffron Magicworks from the underlying dispute, IMPPA shared.

In further updates, Reiterating its role as a neutral platform for practical and cost-effective dispute resolution among members, IMPPA has requested Naik Naik & Company, Anand and Naik, and Complete Cinema to issue corrections to their respective posts and reports. The association also shared it would continue its dispute resolution mechanism while refraining from further comment on the ongoing matter between the two production houses.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Star Faisal Malik as Kumbhakaran and (inset) during the shoot more The star is trending at the No. 1 position on IMDb’s weekly list, with his on-screen brother Yash at the second position.
Adding to this, View this post on Instagram A post shared by IMDb India (@imdb_in)

Meanwhile, Best known for his role as Deputy Pradhan Prahlad Cha in the OTT series Panchayat , the star says, “This is a highly VFX-driven movie and not a normal acting movie. So, I had to unlearn traditional acting methods, as there is a certain way to do things, and we were trained for it by the team, which was of utmost importance.”

Notably, In the movie, he has major scenes with Yash. Sharing details about the process, he says, “Major shooting has been done separately, but I have some critical scenes with him in the second part. We saw Ravana walking on Kumbhakaran’s hand to bless him, so that was shot separately, keeping in mind the eye, face, and body movement. We had seen the making videos of Lord of the Rings and Avatar, but here we got to be part of the amazing process. I feel, before and after this, nothing as grand as this will happen in Indian cinema in the near future.”

As per the latest buzz, He was made to understand that size is the visual focus, so the thrust was on the body rather than on the real face. “Kumbhakaran was the biggest warrior and a demon, so viewers won’t see Faisal on screen,” he says.

In further updates, The star was surprised as got to learn about the process. “Thousands of people working on a scene, including a foreign crew, is amazing. On one character and scene, so many teams are working together and improvising things for days and months. It’s very easy to be critical and say it’s AI. But the fact is most people don’t understand the difference between CGI and AI,” he says.

On top of that, On the massive response to the movie, he says, “People are tagging me in reels, especially the entry one, with lakhs of views. I have got love for Panchayat, and people made widely shared reels and memes. But people taking the pain of recording it from the cinema and flooding the Insta feed is very heartening. Bahut pyaar mil raha hai…bhar-bhar kar.”
Deep Saxena writes on Bollywood, OTT, television, food and culture for the daily Entertainment & Lifestyle supplement, HT City.

Drishyam: The Conclusion OTT rollout: Ajay Devgn’s smash hit thriller arrives on Netflix on November 27. more Directed by Abhishek Pathak, the movie is the third instalment of the Hindi version of Drishyam. Ajay reprised his role as Vijay Salgaonkar, a cable operator who goes to great lengths to protect his family. The movie also stars Tabu, Jaideep Ahlawat , Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Ishita Dutta and Mrunal Jadhav. It also features Prakash Raj as an advocate.

Adding to this, The movie had a successful run at the ticket-window, drawing audiences to theatres for several weeks after its rollout. As per trade tracker Sacnilk, its worldwide collection was around ₹ 589.33 crore rupees after 51 days.

Meanwhile, Drishyam: The Conclusion opened on Gandhi Jayanti with an India net collection of ₹ 62 crore rupees. It went on to earn ₹ 245.50 crore rupees in its first week. Its total India net collection reached ₹ 381.01 crore rupees, while the India gross stood at ₹ 456.13 crore rupees. The overseas collection was reported at ₹ 133.20 crore rupees.

Notably, The numbers made the movie the highest-grossing third instalment in a Bollywood franchise, adding another ticket-window milestone to Ajay Devgn's career. The movie was as per reports made on a budget of ₹ 110 crore rupees.

As per the latest buzz, The first part of Drishyam was rolled out in 2015, followed by the sequel Drishyam 2 in 2022. Unlike a direct continuation of the Malayalam franchise's storyline, starring Mohanlal in the lead role, Drishyam: The Conclusion is the final instalment in the franchise, and it follows its own version of events. It picks up Vijay Salgaonkar's story and brings his long-running tussle with the police to a conclusion. Jaideep Ahlawat plays Rajveer Singh Tomar, a crime branch officer who becomes part of the investigation.

In further updates, An excerpt from the Hindustan Times review read, “Overall, Drishyam: The Conclusion has enough drama and nostalgia to keep the followers engaged. But for a franchise that built its reputation on making the impossible seem plausible, this one asks us to take a few too many things at face value. It has the ingredients of a satisfying finale, just not the trick to pull it off. The mystery may finally be over, but the magic of the first Drishyam remains hard to recreate.”

title: Shah Rukh Khan calls for dialogue over violence at Global Peace Honours event, pays tribute to victims of 26/11 and Pahalgam attack
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Shah Rukh Khan at the Global Peace Honours event. (ANI PICTURE) (HT_PRINT) more Shah Rukh's note "One day, my younger son asked me how hatred could be turned into love. I told him it was very simple. If we all decide to choose dialogue instead of violence, trust instead of fear, and live together in harmony, love will always triumph," the star shared.

Adding to this, "Peace begins in a small place -- within us, in our own hearts. Peace is a decision, a responsibility and a promise that we must fulfil every single day. Never forget the power of the common man. We are all ordinary people, and we all have to come together. So, let us make a small promise today. We do not have to agree with everything. But we must try to understand every person's story. We may do many foolish things, but we should not cause trouble or distress to anyone. Our country, India, is an example of peace, harmony and goodwill," he shared.
Meanwhile, Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis was among those who attended the event, organised by the Divyaj Foundation headed by his wife Amruta Fadnavis.

Notably, Shah Rukh also shared a special message for the country’s soldiers and security personnel, the star recited a few lines about their courage and service to the nation. “My humble tribute to the innocent people who lost their lives in the 26/11 terrorist attack, the Pahalgam terrorist attack, and the recent Delhi blasts and my respectful salute to our brave security personnel who were martyred in these attacks. Today, I have been asked to recite these four beautiful lines for the brave soldiers and jawans of the country,” Shah Rukh shared.

As per the latest buzz, “When someone asks you what you do, say with pride that I protect the country. If someone asks you how much you earn, smile slightly and say, I earn the blessings of 1.4 billion people. And if they turn around and ask you again, Aren't you ever afraid? Look them in the eye and say, those who attack us feel it...Let us all take steps towards peace together. Let us forget the caste, creed, and discrimination around us and walk the path of humanity so that the martyrdom of our heroes for the peace of our country is not in vain,” he added.
In further updates, Sachin Tendulkar and actors Ranveer Singh, Suniel Shetty and Vikrant Massey were present at the event. Shah Rukh will be seen next in King, which will hit theatres on December 24.

title: Ramayana box office collection day 17: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash film recovers on 3rd Saturday, crosses ₹900 crore

By the time of its rollout, the movie had already sold tickets worth ₹ 200 crore rupees worldwide. The movie went on to collect ₹ 64.85 crore rupees in India on its first day of rollout, becoming the fourth-highest opening in Bollywood history. The movie then collected ₹ 107 crore rupees net on Monday and ₹ 94 crore rupees net on Tuesday, both the highest in Indian cinema history. Ramayana has already surpassed the liftime haul of many big blockbusters like Ranveer Singh-starrer Dhurandhar , Vicky Kaushal-starrer Chhaava, Shah Rukh Khan's Pathaan and Ranbir Kapoor's previous theatrical rollout Animal.

title: Amit Sadh on theatrical comeback with Pratap: Getting a perfect release is tough for an indie filmmaker
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Star Amit Sadh With Pratap screening on limited screens (280 shows in India and around 100 overseas), Sadh says it’s becoming increasingly difficult for indie films to get a theatrical rollout.

Adding to this, “In today’s scenario, if the movie is rolled out in a theatre, it is a very big thing! Getting a perfect rollout window and screens is very tough for an independent filmmaker,” says the 47-year-old, who returned to theatres after Gold (2018) and Super 30 (2019).

Meanwhile, However, the star is happy that films like Main Waapas Aaunga , Hanuman Ansh and Pyre have found an audience. “Yes, there are films whose shows have increased, but this rarely happens. Only word of mouth and luck can make it happen! Magic can happen, but only if people watch the movie. We can just do good work to the best of our ability and then leave the rest to destiny and move ahead.”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Amit Sadh (@theamitsadh)

As per the latest buzz, The Kai Po Che! (2013) star terms his recent rollout as a very honest work by director Sachin Shroff. “ It’s a story of karma and redemption which has been beautifully weaved in the movie. For me it was also very interesting to see such a powerful person who is no longer a favourite of the system so what happens to him. Interestingly, it’s a widely shared reel turned upside down and lands him in jail! I loved the duality that on one side he is a President awardee, and his 10-year-old son terms him as a criminal…which was very painful!”

In further updates, While the star featured in OTT projects like Avrodh , Duranga , Jeet Ki Zidd and three seasons of Breathe , he maintains that theatrical releases remain important for actors. His series … Zidd was of late made into a movie and rolled out on OTT. He featured in web films including Shakuntala Devi and Pune Highway .

On top of that, “While OTT gave us a lot of work and love, the thrill of the 70mm screen is always there for actors. It’s great that big films like Ramayana are working, but then small films should also get a fair chance to survive!” he says.

15 years in industry does he get butterflies in his stomach? “I will somehow get butterflies in my stomach with everything I do. First of all, I am in the best of the profession and very happy to be here to be able to do what I love most. I am grateful for everything that happens – I am travelling, riding a bike or anything,” he ends.

title: Salman Khan responds to Maatrubhumi trailer criticism; tells audience not to judge the film by its five-minute trailer
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

title: Hanuman Ansh director Vishal Chaturvedi calls out industry silence after 452 crore success, says no big production house has made a statement
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Hanuman Ansh director questions industry bias after small movie delivers a ₹452 crore rupees box-office triumph. more Vishal Chaturvedi on no support from movie industry In conversation with Screen ahead of the movie’s OTT premiere, Vishal shared he was surprised that none of the major production houses had publicly acknowledged its success. “I have seen so many official statements after a big movie works at the ticket-window, but because ours is a small movie by a first-time director, I didn’t see any statement from any big production house, not even one. That’s very surprising,” he shared, adding, “But when people meet me, they speak volumes about the movie. There are only a few people with big hearts who lauded it out loud, including Varun Dhawan, Virender Sehwag, and many others. No big studio or established production house wrote a letter or statement about the success of the movie”.

Adding to this, Vishal also reflected on the movie’s success while attending the 57th International Movie Festival of India (IFFI) 2026 in Goa. He shared Hanuman Ansh has proved that a movie does not need a big budget or a star-studded cast to draw audiences to theatres.

Meanwhile, “Theatre is an event place. When an event movie comes, it works. This is the norm that I have been hearing, that only these kinds of films will work and the rest will have to struggle. But our movie proves all these theories wrong,” he added, by saying, “That myth has been broken, that only a big star, a big budget, or a major studio can make a movie successful,” he added. “Cinema is a people’s medium. The audience watches and decides if it’s a good movie, but earlier it was the critics and social media that used to give that conclusion to the people”.

Notably, Starring Shobhinaw Satyaa as Neem Karoli Baba, Hanuman Ansh will start streaming on Sony LIV on November 27. The movie rolled out in theatres on August 7 and will also be shown on Sony MAX. The television premiere date is yet to be revealed. Hanuman Ansh tells the story of Lakshminarayan, who begins his search for God after losing his mother. His spiritual journey eventually leads him to become the saint known for his teachings of love, compassion and seva. The movie is based on director Vishal Chaturvedi's book, Divine Detour: That Changed My Life.

title: Salman Khan confirms Dabangg sequel is in the works, rules out Bajrangi Bhaijaan 2: “I don’t think it is possible”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star discussed the future of both franchises, explaining why he does not want a follow-up to the 2015 movie to be compared unfavourably with the original.

Adding to this, Asked about the future of Dabangg , which introduced audiences to the much-loved character of Chulbul Pandey in 2010, Salman suggested that the decision to take the franchise forward remains within his family’s control. The movie spawned two sequels, rolled out in 2012 and 2019, respectively.

Meanwhile, Sharing an update, the star shared, “ Dabangg ka toh aa hi jaayega. Yeh toh humare haath mein hai. Baaki films unke haath mein hai (A Dabangg sequel will definitely happen. That is in our hands. The rest of the films are in their hands).”

Notably, However, his response was markedly different when he was asked about Bajrangi Bhaijaan 2 . Salman explained that he does not believe another movie could match the emotional connect of the original and would rather not risk audiences comparing the two films unfavourably. The 2015 movie, directed by Kabir Khan, featured Salman as Pawan Kumar Chaturvedi, a man who helps a young Pakistani girl reunite with her family.
As per the latest buzz, #BajrangiBhaijaan sequel nahi aayega. Usse better movie banana possible nahi.
In further updates, #SalmanKhan on sequels of #BB #Kick at ABP conclave. https://t.co/DuZG9Dxq3d

On top of that, Elaborating on his position, Salman shared, “ Bajrangi ka aisa hai ke Bajrangi ke upar koi movie jaana, I don’t think it is possible – emotionally and its connect. Toh woh karna hi nahi jahan par yeh second movie first movie se compare hue aur bole ki yaar ismein mazaa nahi aaya. So yaa, I don’t think Bajrangi Bhaijaan (sequel) banegi (The thing with Bajrangi is that for any movie to surpass Bajrangi , I don’t think it is possible – emotionally and its connect. So, I don’t want to do something where the second movie gets compared to the first movie and people say, 'It wasn’t as enjoyable.' So yeah, I don’t think a Bajrangi Bhaijaan sequel will be made).”

For now, Salman’s next theatrical outing is Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace . Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, the patriotic drama also stars Chitrangada Singh and is scheduled to rollout in theatres on December 4, 2026.

title: Madhur Bhandarkar says Dhurandhar was the right choice for Indian Panorama opening film at IFFI
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Madhur Bhandarkar says the selection of Dhurandhar for IFFI was an unanimous choice. more What Madhur shared The filmmaker, who is chairperson of the jury for the Indian Panorama section, shared the decision was taken collectively by him and the other jury members. "The way it has been shot, the way it has been made, and being a popular movie, it's a very commercial smash hit movie. People have loved it, people have loved the songs also, and performance-wise also, Ranveer Singh, everybody acted so well," he shared.

Adding to this, "I thought that this movie has to be the opening movie. It's a big movie, and everybody has loved it. People, I know, have watched the movie two, three times. So I thought that was the right movie, and that's the reason Dhurandhar was the movie," he shared.

Meanwhile, Speaking about his association with IFFI, Bhandarkar shared he has been connected with the festival in different capacities over the years, including as a member of its steering committee, a jury chairperson and as a filmmaker whose films have been showcased there. Notably, The Indian Panorama Section is one of IFFI’s flagship sections and includes the best of Indian cinema, with a special focus on films outside the mainstream and from regional languages and cultures otherwise hidden from the mainstream.

On top of that, The first movie was rolled out in theatres on December 5, 2025, and Dhurandhar 2 on March 19 this year. title: Amit Shah reaches out to Siang dam protesters in Arunachal, says concerns will be resolved through dialogue
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Union Home Minister Amit Shah will be in the city on November 15 and 16. (File photo) more Speaking at an event in Itanagar, Shah shared the 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) will play a pivotal role in the development of the country and the state. He added that he was aware of the apprehensions of people over the project and had come to Arunachal Pradesh to address their concerns directly.

Adding to this, “I want to make it clear to my brothers and sisters of Siang that the government will hold discussions with the people. We will take you into confidence, and only through dialogue will the road ahead be paved. There is no need to worry,” he shared at a ceremony held to confer the President’s Colour on the Arunachal Pradesh Police.

Meanwhile, Shah’s remarks after protests against the proposed power project turned violent in East Siang district, with demonstrators torching the office of a PSU, setting fire to a police station, vandalising the residences of three political leaders and injuring police personnel in October. The violence followed a 12-hour bandh on and came a day after four people were injured when police fired tear gas shells to disperse protesters. Chief minister Pema Khandu condemned the clashes and urged protesters to pursue their demands through peaceful and democratic means.

Notably, Opposition to the project stems from fears that the dam could displace local communities, damage the fragile ecosystem and submerge ancestral lands. The central and state governments, however, consider the project a strategic safeguard against China’s massive hydropower development upstream in Tibet.

As per the latest buzz, “The government and I have the same respect you have for the local culture. We will move forward without compromising the traditions, culture and religion of this place,” Shah shared, stressing that any future decision on the project will be taken by taking the local residents along.

In further updates, On Friday, the Adi Ba:né Kébang United (ABKU), an outfit representing the Adi community, and the Siang Indigenous Farmers’ Forum (SIFF), submitted a joint memorandum to Shah, demanding an immediate halt to pre-feasibility activities, the rollout of detained protesters, the withdrawal of security forces and a judicial inquiry into the October 23 violence in Siang district.

On top of that, Shah also promised “one of the country’s best” rehabilitation and resettlement packages for people who could be affected by the proposed dam. Appealing to organisations and residents opposing the project, he urged them to engage with the state government, which could facilitate further discussions with the Union home ministry.
There was no immediate reaction to the groups opposing the project to Shah’s statements.

title: Salman Khan says there's ‘no way’ Maatrubhumi would clash with Shah Rukh Khan and Suhana's King; okay to face off Avengers Doomsday, Dune 3
body: Here's the latest update from the Hollywood/Marvel world:

At a summit hosted by ABP in Hyderabad, Salman talked about Maatrubhumi after promoting the movie in the city. Explaining why he picked its rollout date, he added, “ Shah Rukh is coming on December 24. I am not going to clash with Shah Rukh and his daughter, Suhana. No way. Now, these two films that are releasing, Avengers and Dune, I will clash with them anytime. But they’re coming out a week before. I don’t have a problem clashing with them at all. Now, if I leave my rollout date, Shah Rukh’s movie comes out one week later. Never wanna clash.”

Adding to this, He also pondered how he could pick a date early next year, but why he didn’t want to do that. “Then, there’s January 26, it’s a good date. Sanjay Leela Bhansali is coming with Vicky, Ranbir and Alia. So, I didn’t want to clash with them either. Now, next week after that, again a good date, but then there’s another movie coming out in March. And that’s Monster. And I don’t want to clash with myself,” added Salman as the audience burst out laughing.

Meanwhile, Maatrubhumi will now clash with Laxman Utekar’s Shraddha Kapoor-starrer Eetha , and the star had ‘three cheers’ for it. Avengers: Doomsday is releasing on December 17 and Dune 3 on December 18.

Notably, Maatrubhumi is directed by Apoorva Lakhia and produced by Salman Khan under his Salman Khan Films banner. Chitrangada Singh, Anoop Bikram Shahi and Prashant Tamang also star in it. The movie was initially titled Battle of Galwan, but the title was changed, and it underwent a rehaul. At a promotional event, Salman admitted that Apoorva had a different story .

As per the latest buzz, Addressing criticism for the movie’s promotional material in Hyderabad, Salman shared, “Our movie is about the country’s soldiers and their families. And instead of that, you talk about VFX and AI. Who are these people? Where do they come from?” He also added, “Are these people AI specialists? Are they VFX specialists? They think it does not look like Salman Khan shot this scene; it must be someone else. So, for your knowledge, let me tell you that I might not see all this, but my team does.”

These include enhanced security for Saif Ali Khan, Amitabh Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan and their families; safety measures for movie personalities and filmmakers across Mumbai; adequate police protection at shooting locations; strict action against gangsters and their networks; and close monitoring of press conferences and public events involving movie personalities.

title: Ramayana box office collection Day 16: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film crosses ₹875 crore, becomes second-fastest to cross ₹650 crore in Hindi
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's movie has crossed ₹870 crore rupees at the ticket-window. more Ramayana ticket-window earnings According to Sacnilk, Ramayana collected ₹ 13.27 crore rupees on Friday, Day 16, taking its total India net collection to ₹ 877.02 crore rupees. Its overall occupancy stood at around 20%. On Thursday, the movie collected ₹ 19.35 crore rupees, but collections dropped on Friday.

Adding to this, The movie opened in theatres with ₹ 64.85 crore rupees on November 5. It witnessed an unprecedented jump during the Diwali holidays, collecting ₹ 107.50 crore rupees on November 9, a day after Diwali. After its first eight days in theatres, Ramayana had collected ₹ 564.60 crore rupees at the domestic ticket-window. The movie continued its strong run in the second week, earning ₹ 299.15 crore rupees between Days 9 and 15.

Meanwhile, Ramayana has also achieved a major milestone in the Hindi ticket-window. The movie crossed the ₹ 650-crore rupees mark in Hindi net collections in 15 days, becoming the second-fastest movie to achieve the feat. It is behind Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge, which reached the milestone in just nine days.

Notably, The movie has beaten Pushpa 2, which took 17 days to cross the ₹ 650-crore rupees mark in Hindi, while Dhurandhar achieved the feat in 23 days. Ramayana has thus joined the list of the fastest Hindi films to reach the milestone.

As per the latest buzz, Taran Adarsh noted that Ramayana has no major competition at the ticket-window for now and is expected to enjoy a good run for another week. However, the movie will face competition from Yeh Prem Mol Liya and Gunmaaster G9 when they rollout on November 27. He wrote, "#Ramayana [#Hindi version] posts a sensational total in Week 2, following a phenomenal run in its extended Week 1… The movie is expected to continue its dominance at the boxoffice this week as well – making it three consecutive weeks without any major opposition. #Ramayana will face competition from #YehPremMolLiya and #GunmaasterG9 next Friday [27 Nov 2026], when its screens, shows, and footfalls will be divided."

In further updates, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The movie is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash. It's second part is scheduled to rollout in 2028.

title: Salman Khan says ‘don't judge a book by its cover’ over criticism for Maatrubhumi trailer; shuts down ‘AI-VFX specialists’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Salman Khan addressed criticism for his soon-to-release movie Maatrubhumi's trailer. (AFP) more Salman Khan addresses criticism for Maatrubhumi trailer At the press conference in Hyderabad, Salman was asked about the trolling after Maatrubhumi’s trailer had received; he shared, “If talking badly about my movie or me helps them gain views, or followers, or helps them gain fame and make money, I am more than happy. God bless them.”

Adding to this, He also addressed those who thought the whole movie was shown in the movie, saying, “Those saying this is too long or thinking that we have shown the whole movie, we haven’t. I will show you the whole movie on December 4. What is it that they say? Never judge a book by its cover? But you have already judged it by its cover. Now what will happen when things flip? God willing, it will. Now, if you found so many points to pick from in a 5-minute trailer, imagine how much will you find in a two and a half hour movie.”

Meanwhile, After the song Madirapan from Maatrubhumi was rolled out, there were those who believed Salman did not shoot for it, or alleged AI usage. The trailer also faced similar scrutiny. Seemingly addressing the chatter around both, Salman shared, “Our movie is about the country’s soldiers and their families. And instead of that, you talk about VFX and AI. Who are these people? Where do they come from?”

Notably, The star also added, “Are these people AI specialists? Are they VFX specialists? They think it does not look like Salman Khan shot this scene; it must be someone else. So, for your knowledge, let me tell you that I might not see all this, but my team does.” Salman also pointed out that scenes shot in real locations have been criticised for the supposed use of VFX. He sarcastically thanked the naysayers, asking them not to concentrate on the soldiers or the story they were showing.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Sanjay Kapoor, Prashant Narayanan and Esther Anil to star in crime thriller UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH, first-look poster unveiled
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Presented by YASH VEERA FILMS and produced by Pyarelal Gundecha (Sojat Road Wala), the movie is directed and shot by 'Garudavega' Anji. The project also features Prithvi Raj, Thambi Ramaiah, Sanjay Singh and Ganja Karuppu in significant roles.

Adding to this, Sanjay Kapoor will be seen playing SSP Bharat Singh, an investigating police officer entrusted with probing a case connected to Dehradun's Inter-State Bus Terminal (ISBT). The movie's narrative revolves around the disappearance of a teenage girl following a misunderstanding at home, which is triggered by a planted love letter. Matters take a serious turn when she boards a night bus from Dehradun ISBT and subsequently goes missing.

Meanwhile, The discovery of an abandoned bus and the girl's subsequent admission to a government hospital in an unconscious state lead to a police investigation. As the authorities attempt to piece together the circumstances surrounding the incident, several unanswered questions emerge. Through this storyline, the movie explores the complexities of police investigations and the challenges law enforcement agencies face while uncovering the truth in sensitive cases.
Notably, Prashant Narayanan, known for his performances in films such as Murder 2 , Bhag Johnny and Dharam Sankat Mein , also plays a significant role in the investigative thriller.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about his character, Sanjay Kapoor says, “Playing an investigating police officer in UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH has been a meaningful experience. What makes this movie important is its connection with a sensitive real-life subject. Incidents involving women’s safety are not just headlines; they remind us of our collective responsibility as a society. Through my character, we hope to highlight the importance of a thorough investigation and the pursuit of truth. I believe cinema can play an important role in bringing such issues into public conversation.”

In further updates, Prashant Narayanan also spoke about his association with the project, stating, “UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH deals with a subject that is both sensitive and socially relevant. Stories inspired by real incidents carry a certain responsibility, and as actors, it is important for us to approach such narratives with honesty and conviction. I was drawn to the movie because of its gripping storyline and the larger message it seeks to convey. I hope audiences connect with the movie and the questions it raises.”

On top of that, Producer Pyarelal Gundecha (Sojat Road Wala) highlighted the intention behind bringing the story to the screen. He shared, “As a producer, I believe cinema has the power to entertain while also bringing important social issues into the spotlight. With UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH, our intention is to present a compelling story inspired by real incidents and highlight the importance of women’s safety, justice and responsible policing. We have brought together a talented cast and technical team to create a movie that resonates with audiences across the country. I hope the movie encourages meaningful conversations while delivering a powerful cinematic experience.”

Director and cinematographer 'Garudavega' Anji also shared his perspective on the project, saying, “UNEXPECTED – SAFED SACH goes beyond conventional crime-thriller storytelling. Inspired by real incidents, the movie aims to initiate conversations around women’s safety, public responsibility and the importance of understanding the consequences of situations that can change lives. Our intention is to present an engaging cinematic experience while addressing a subject that deserves wider attention.”

title: Party Animals review: Nothing really gets the party going in this Viraj Ghelani-Alam Khan buddy comedy
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Party Animals, directed by Ravi Chhabriya, tries too hard to be funny. more Party Animals story Directed by Ravi Chhabriya, the story revolves around Mann (Viraj Ghelani), who throws a grand party in Mumbai in the hopes of proposing to the girl he likes. He insists that his childhood friend, Armaan Khanna (Arjun Tanwar), who is gearing up for his movie debut, also attend the bash. Sohail (Saqib Ayub) and Danish (Alam Khan) help Mann with the arrangements, but their own personal troubles, coupled with the party spiralling out of control, form the crux of the story.

Adding to this, The biggest problem here is that the movie tries far too hard to be funny. Written by Ali Haji, Khushi Mullick and Veer Panchal, it begins by establishing the bond between Mann and Armaan during their school days before transitioning to their adult lives. The first half is largely about setting the stage, introducing its crazy characters. Its collaboration with music label Sa Re Ga Ma (also produced by the label under its production house) also results in several old classics being rehashed, including Aa Dekhein Zara and Raat Baaki Baat Baaki. None of this is particularly bad, but it's not particularly entertaining either.

Meanwhile, Very little actually lands. The humour is bland, and the movie's attempt to replicate Kunal Kemmu 's brand of comedy, seen in films such as Madgaon Express, is evident. Yet, unlike those films, Party Animals doesn't have enough sharp writing or genuinely funny situations to make its chaos work.

Notably, The second half drags a little, with a romantic track running parallel to the main plot. By the time the movie reaches its climax, you realise that the party itself, which was supposed to be the movie's central attraction, has taken a backseat. Instead of watching a celebration spiral into chaos, you find yourself spending more time on distractions that do little to advance the story.

As per the latest buzz, Performance-wise, Arjun Tanwar, playing the star kid, delivers a decent performance, while Alam Khan is effective in his role. Viraj Ghelani is a natural and fits the character of Mann quite well. He brings an easygoing vibe to the role, but the material simply doesn't do enough to complement his efforts. The cast is game, but the writing leaves them with very little to work with. Pragati Nagpal as Zara is good. Kamlesh Sawant and Vijay Patkar are wasted in their roles as the sympathetic cops.

In further updates, Overall, Party Animals wants to be a wild ride fuelled by friendship and misadventures, but there is very little here that genuinely gets the party going. The jokes rarely land, and the story takes unnecessary detours. The cast brings some energy to the proceedings, but the writing lets them down. For all the cussing and late-night revelry, Party Animals is missing the one thing a party should never be short of: fun.

On top of that, Rishabh Suri is an Assistant Editor, movie critic, and professional overthinker of plot points. He writes for HT City, keeping pace with an industry where news cycles expire long before the popcorn gets cold. He completed his graduation in English Honours from Kirori Mal College, followed by a Master’s degree in English Literature-effectively training his brain to over-analyse classic texts before applying those exact same skills to 3-hour Bollywood blockbusters. He got into the profession when he had barely graduated from college and has been at HT ever since. At HT, Rishabh reviews films with a simple rule: skip the dense academic jargon and get straight to the point. Beyond reviews, as Assistant Editor, he helps navigate the broader circus of showbiz, tracking everything from OTT shifts to sudden ticket-window panics. In a beat driven by loud PR machinery and carefully scripted answers, Rishabh prefers cutting through the noise to focus on how stories get made and why trends shift. When he isn’t writing against a deadline, he is usually sitting in a dark theater, compulsively memorising dialogues. For Rishabh, analysing movies isn't just a day job- it’s a habit he couldn't turn off even if he tried.

title: India declines comment on Tarique Rahman’s ‘across the border’ jibe over Bangladesh unrest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

India on Friday refused to be drawn on Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s accusation that protests by the Awami League were being directed by masters “across the border” and reiterated its long-standing position that it desires positive and constructive ties with the neighbouring country.

Adding to this, When external affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal was asked about Rahman’s remarks, he replied: “I have no comments to make on the internal developments in Bangladesh.” Parts of Bangladesh witnessed violence on Thursday as members of the party of former premier Sheikh Hasina attempted to bring businesses and public transport to a halt. The Awami League called a nationwide lockdown on Thursday at the end of a week-long campaign of protests against the government’s rejection of Hasina’s request for a new passport to enable her to return home from India, where she has lived in self-exile since August 2024.

Meanwhile, When external affairs ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal was asked about Rahman’s remarks blaming the unrest on India and Awami League leaders based in the neighbouring country, he replied: “I have no comments to make on the internal developments in Bangladesh.”

Notably, While addressing a public event at Lalmonirhat in northern Bangladesh on Thursday, Rahman shared Awami League leaders “have not looked at ​the interests of Bangladesh and its people”. Without naming India, he added, “At the same time, the country across the border, where they have fled to, is their master…To ​satisfy those masters, they have again started conspiring against Bangladesh and its people.”

As per the latest buzz, The lockdown called by the Awami League was successful mostly in southern areas where the party has a strong presence. Police shared two members of the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party were killed on Wednesday night, and the houses of two BNP lawmakers in Hasina’s home district of Gopalganj were vandalised.

In further updates, Jaiswal repeated India’s long-standing stance on ties with Bangladesh, telling a regular media briefing: “Our position remains consistent — that India desires a positive, constructive and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh, one which is rooted in the shared histories of the two countries and in their shared cultural ties of their peoples.”

On top of that, Hasina’s London-based lawyers sent a second request seeking a passport and a national identity card for her to the Bangladesh high commission on Thursday. Hasina first sought a passport in connection with her planned homecoming earlier this month, but this was rejected by officials in Dhaka, who reiterated Bangladesh’s request for her extradition.
Jaiswal shared he had “no update” on the extradition issue. In the past, he has shared the extradition request is a legal matter and will be dealt with accordingly.

title: Cine workers' body writes to Maharashtra CM requesting stronger security for Saif Ali Khan, Amitabh Bachchan after threats
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Saif Ali Khan and Amitabh Bachchan of late received threats from gangsters. more Cine workers’ body’s letter to the CM AICWA president Suresh Shyamlal Gupta wrote to the CM and sent a copy to Mumbai police commissioner Deven Bharti seeking urgent protection for Bollywood. Mentioning that gangsters have openly threatened several actors in the last few weeks, claiming to have 200 shooters at their disposal, the workers’ body pointed out that if the situation continues, it will begin to affect movie shoots.

Adding to this, “The livelihood of lakhs of workers, technicians, artists and set workers is now at risk. If this continues, a lock will fall on Bollywood: shootings will stop completely, workers will lose their jobs and producers will suffer heavy losses,” read a portion of the letter, adding, “Bollywood contributes significantly to the nation's revenue and carries India's name across the world. Every such incident damages that reputation. Because movie personalities are visible and seen as soft targets, gangsters attack them for publicity and extortion.”

Meanwhile, Stating that it feels like Bollywood is back in the 1990s under the underworld's grip, the AICWA put forth five demands to protect the movie industry. “Stronger security for Saif Ali Khan, Shri Amitabh Bachchan, Abhishek Bachchan and their families. Safety for all movie personalities and filmmakers in Mumbai. Adequate police protection at all shooting locations,” read a few of their demands.

Notably, The others read, “Strict action against gangsters and their networks, and a gangster-free Mumbai. Close monitoring of press conferences and public events involving movie personalities.” The workers’ body also wrote: “Bollywood must be able to move freely on Mumbai's streets, shoot and work without fear.”

As per the latest buzz, This comes after Mumbai Police told news agency PTI on Thursday that they have started an investigation into the alleged death threat received by Saif and are verifying its authenticity. “Star Saif Ali Khan received a voice message on his phone in the name of Zeeshan Akhtar, stating that he would meet the same fate as Baba Siddique,” a police official was quoted as saying.

title: Darsheel Safary and Zain Khan Durrani team up for Alok Naik's cybercrime thriller Cyber
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Cyber follows two unemployed computer engineering graduates who get an opportunity to work with a cyber agency. What initially appears to be a chance to put their technical knowledge and abilities to use soon takes them into the complicated world of cybercrime and investigations. As they navigate their new responsibilities, the two find themselves dealing with situations that bring unexpected changes to their lives.

Adding to this, Beyond its crime-based narrative, the movie also focuses on unemployment, personal aspirations and the struggles of young individuals trying to establish themselves. Through the journeys of its central characters, Cyber looks at the challenges faced by two graduates as they search for opportunities and a sense of purpose.

Meanwhile, The movie is produced by Raj Zacharias under the banner of Celebs and Red Carpet. The production house has previously backed several South Indian films, including Anwar , starring Prithviraj, Lalbagh and Rahadari , among others. With Cyber , the production banner is making its debut in Hindi cinema.

Notably, Alongside Darsheel Safary and Zain Khan Durrani, the movie features an ensemble cast comprising Ajit Koshy, Kabir Duhan Singh, Prasad Oak, Alisha Khan, Ayushi Tyagi, Soumya Srivastav, Rahul Singh and Vitthal Kale.

As per the latest buzz, Talking about the reason behind backing the project, producer Raj Zacharias shared, "What attracted me to this was it's a story of two engineering graduates who are jobless and trying to do something in life. It's a common man's story. It's a pure, raw and realistic storyline about how they get a chance to work with a cyber agency and how their life changes."

In further updates, The movie's music has been composed by award-winning musician Gopi Sundar CS, who is known for his work in films such as Geetha Govindam , Bangalore Days and Charlie . He has also contributed to several projects across Malayalam, Telugu and Tamil cinema.

On top of that, With a storyline centred on cybercrime and the realities of unemployment, Cyber brings together a contemporary subject, investigative elements and the experiences of two young graduates. The movie marks a new collaboration between Darsheel Safary and Zain Khan Durrani, while also introducing the production banner to Hindi cinema.'
