title: Western Railway halts demolition in Mumbai's Prabhadevi amid protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Western Railway (WR) revealed on Friday that it was putting on hold the planned demolition of 102 unauthorised structures on railway land near the western side of Mumbai's Prabhadevi railway station.

Adding to this, UBT Sena MLA Ajay Chaudhary shared the WR general manager sent a message to MNS leader Bala Nandgaonkar, informing him that the demolition drive had been stopped. (PTI | Representational image) In a statement, the Western Railway shared that the demolition of encroachments has been temporarily postponed and that a comprehensive policy will be formulated.

Meanwhile, "The issue involves a substantial extent of encroachment on railway land and requires a comprehensive and permanent solution. The railway administration, in coordination with the state government, is working towards formulating a long-term policy framework to address the issue in a sustainable manner. Accordingly, further action at the site will be taken after the policy-level solution is finalised," the media statement read.
Notably, UBT Sena MLA Ajay Chaudhary shared WR general manager sent a message to MNS leader Bala Nandgaonkar, informing him that the demolition drive had been stopped.

As per the latest buzz, Former Shiv Sena corporator Samadhan Sarvankar shared the decision came after Maharashtra deputy chief Minister Eknath Shinde spoke to Union railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw on Friday morning amid legal intervention and protests by residents. Shinde also holds the urban development portfolio.

In further updates, “We sent the videos of the protest to Shinde Saheb. The slum dwellers are not getting alternative accommodation. This is not correct. Seeing the protest, Shinde spoke to Ashwini Vaishnaw and got the demolition stopped. Slum dwellers can be moved only after the alternate accommodation is given,” he shared.

On top of that, Residents staged a protest by sitting and lying in front of the JCB machinery, forcing officials to stop the operation. The demolition drive aimed to clear two chawls and several ground-floor and one-floor rooms to make way for residential quarters for railway employees.
The eviction action, originally scheduled for Thursday, could not proceed after the affected residents approached the Bombay high court.

title: Mohitt Maalik to play antagonist opposite Tiger Shroff in spiritual action film Vajra
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mohitt of late drew attention for his portrayal of Birju Lohar, a character that became one of his widely discussed performances. With Vajra , the star is now set to explore another distinct role, stepping into the antagonist space. The movie's action-driven narrative will give him an opportunity to experiment with a different character and present another side of his acting.

Adding to this, Another aspect of the project that has generated interest is Mohitt's first-time collaboration with Tiger Shroff. Known for his action-oriented roles and screen presence, Tiger will share screen space with Mohitt in a movie that is expected to feature several action sequences. Their on-screen equation is likely to be an important element of the narrative, with Mohitt's antagonist role setting up a conflict with the lead character.

Meanwhile, Speaking about the project, a source close to the development shares, “Mohitt has an interesting character in Vajra . He will be playing an antagonist opposite Tiger Shroff, and it is a role that gives him an opportunity to explore a different space as an star. After Birju Lohar, this is another distinct character for him. It will also be interesting to see Mohitt and Tiger share screen space for the first time, especially in a movie that has action at its core.”

Notably, With Vajra , Mohitt Maalik is adding another project to his soon-to-release lineup. The movie will see him move away from the kind of character he of late portrayed as Birju Lohar and take on a role with a different set of challenges. His collaboration with Tiger Shroff, along with the movie's spiritual action backdrop and Japan schedule, adds to the interest surrounding the project. Further details about the movie and the characters are awaited.

title: IFFI gives documentaries a bigger screen, rolls out red carpet for MIFF winners
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Panaji, The International Movie Festival of India has added a dedicated documentary section and a special showcase for Mumbai International Movie Festival award winners to broaden opportunities for non-fiction filmmakers, festival director Ashutosh Gowariker shared on Friday.

Adding to this, IFFI gives documentaries a bigger screen, rolls out red carpet for MIFF winners Addressing a press conference ahead of the eight-day festival's opening here, Gowariker shared the move aims to ensure documentary makers have two major showcase opportunities each year alongside new categories for animation and docudramas.

Meanwhile, "MIFF is an important festival of ours, which focuses only on documentaries and short films. But documentaries are being made much more, and we want to allow documentary filmmakers to have two festivals in a year," he shared.
Notably, He added that filmmakers would have an opportunity to showcase their works if they missed either of these festivals.
As per the latest buzz, IFFI has also organised a special gala for MIFF award winners, where their films will be showcased in a 90-minute presentation.
In further updates, Gowariker shared the gala would provide a red-carpet platform to recognise and celebrate filmmakers whose works received awards at MIFF.

On top of that, The theme of this year's IFFI, 'Stories Without Borders', has been chosen against the backdrop of conflicts across the world and social divisions within societies, the filmmaker shared.
He explained that the theme goes beyond geographical boundaries and addresses divisions within families, between communities and those arising from caste, religion and other socio-cultural factors.

title: Ananya Panday says younger generation still seeks true love, but won't settle down as standards are 'very high' now
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Ananya Panday was one of the speakers at the 24th edition of the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026 , where she spoke about her career, Bollywood today and more. During her conversation with Sonal Kalra, Chief Managing Editor, Entertainment and Lifestyle, Hindustan Times, the question of marriage and settling down came.

Adding to this, Ananya Panday opened up about marriage and relationships at the HTLS 2026. (Getty Images via AFP) Ananya addresses GenZ’s reluctance to getting married During the conversation, it was noted that female actors today do not shy away from discussing their personal lives and relationships, unlike their counterparts in the 70s and 80s. But while actors are more open to marriage during the peak of their careers, youngsters outside cinema seem reluctant to settle down early. Ananya responded, “I think the reluctance could have been there in the past too; people just didn't have the choice to say no. Now, this generation is seeing enough examples to stand up and say no. For me, it is tough to answer a question like this because I am a very romantic person. For me, love is everything, and I would love to get married eventually. At some point, I'd like to be married and have children. I see my friends around me are exactly the same.”

Meanwhile, Ananya shared that this generation has more options when it comes to love, but their idea of love remains the same as earlier. “I think now we just have a lot more options. But that doesn't change the fact that we don't believe in true love. We are also still seeking that,” she added.

Notably, Ananya was on stage with filmmaker Imtiaz Ali, who is known for his sensitive depiction of love on the big screen. Earlier in the conversation, Imtiaz had spoken about how the younger generation has a very old-school idea of love. Building on that, Ananya added, “As Imtiaz sir shared, we have this very nostalgic feeling of love that we probably haven't experienced. So, our standards of love are also very high. We are not going to settle for just anything.”

As per the latest buzz, Ananya had only one rollout in 2026 - the romantic drama Chand Mera Dil, co-starring Lakshya. The movie received mixed-to-positive reviews but could not work wonders at the ticket-window. Ananya will next be seen in the second season of her successful Amazon Prime Video show, Call Me Bae .

In further updates, Created by Ishita Moitra, the show stars Ananya in the titular role, while Shruti Haasan joins the cast for season 2. The ensemble also includes Vir Das, Gurfateh Pirzada, Varun Sood, Vihaan Samat, Muskkaan Jaferi, Niharika Lyra Dutt, Lisa Mishra, and Mini Mathur. Call Me Bae season 2 premieres on Prime Video on December 17.

On top of that, Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well. A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. Even as his role has evolved from reporter to supervisor over the years, his first love remains writing (and of late, talking on camera). With a good understanding of cinema and its trends, and a keen eye for detail, he continues to spark conversations around showbiz for readers around the world. Read More

title: Aditya Dhar recalls 20-year journey to becoming an 'overnight sensation' with Dhurandhar, credits wife Yami Gautam for changing his fate
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Filmmaker Aditya Dhar rose to widespread fame with his Dhurandhar films , which rollout late last year and in March 2026. At a recent awards event, the filmmaker spoke about his journey in the movie industry and revealed how he feels Yami Gautam 's entry into his life changed his destiny, calling her the lady luck of his life.

Adding to this, Aditya Dhar says Yami Gautam is his Lady Luck. Aditya Dhar credits wife Yami Gautam for changing his fate Yami and Aditya were honoured at the CNN-News18 Indian of the Year 2026 awards, where Aditya credited his wife for bringing good fortune into his life. The filmmaker shared, "I can only say that it took me 20 years to become an overnight sensation. So, it’s been quite a hell of a journey. And the graph has been quite an exciting one. I’m really, really thankful that I’m married to one of the most beautiful human beings I have ever met. My fate changed the moment she entered my life. And I feel that it’s all the lady luck which is helping me tell the Bharat story to the world."

Meanwhile, Yami also spoke about Aditya’s commitment to his craft, recalling how he would spend nearly 70 hours on set without sleeping, completely immersed in bringing his vision to life. She added that taking on such ambitious projects demanded immense courage and the conviction to see them through.
Notably, Aditya and Yami tied the knot in an intimate ceremony in Himachal Pradesh on June 4, 2021. The couple welcomed their son, Vedavid, in May 2024.

As per the latest buzz, Aditya moved to Mumbai in 2006 to pursue a career in filmmaking. He initially worked as an assistant director while also exploring lyric writing and screenwriting. Before making his directorial debut, Aditya worked as a lyricist and screenwriter, contributing to films such as Aakrosh (2010) and Tezz (2012). He also worked on the dialogues and screenplay of Kabul Express (2006).

In further updates, His major breakthrough came with Uri: The Surgical Strike in 2019, starring Vicky Kaushal. Based on the 2016 Indian Army surgical strike, the movie marked Aditya's directorial debut and became a major commercial success, collecting ₹ 341 crore rupees worldwide. It won him the National Movie Award for Best Director, while Vicky Kaushal received the National Movie Award for Best Star.

On top of that, Following the success of Uri, Aditya co-founded the production house B62 Studios with his brother Lokesh Dhar in 2019. He went on to write and produce projects such as Article 370 (2024), which starred his wife, Yami Gautam, and was directed by Aditya Suhas Jambhale. He also co-wrote and co-produced Dhoom Dhaam (2025) and worked on Baramulla (2025).

After a gap of nearly seven years as a director, Aditya returned with Dhurandhar in 2025, starring Ranveer Singh. The movie marked another major milestone in his career, establishing him as a filmmaker capable of mounting large-scale commercial entertainers and turning him into an overnight sensation. It broke several box-office records and collected over ₹ 1,300 crore rupees worldwide. His next rollout, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, became the first Indian movie to collect ₹ 1,000 crore rupees at the domestic ticket-window.

title: After minting ₹90 crore at the box office, Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's The Vvaan arrives on OTT
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

After enjoying a good run at the ticket-window, crossing ₹ 90 crore rupees in worldwide gross, Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia's fantasy mystery drama, The Vvaan : Force of the Forest has now made its way to OTT. The movie began streaming on Prime Video on Friday.

Adding to this, The Vvaan had a good run at the ticket-window. The Vvaan releases on OTT Directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra, the movie's story is rooted in Indian folklore, where an age-old belief, a sacred forest and one man's reckless defiance ignite a ferocious supernatural battle. The official Instagram handle of Prime Video shared the update, writing, "The forest is now calling for you 🌳 #TheVvaanOnPrime, Watch Now."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by prime video IN (@primevideoin)

Notably, Speaking about the movie, director Deepak Kumar Mishra shared, “With The Vvaan, we wanted to tell a story that feels rooted in the soil it comes from. The story, written and produced by Arunabh Kumar, draws from his childhood experiences, and I am grateful to him for bringing this story to us and for the opportunity to collaborate in bringing it to life on screen. We’ve all grown up hearing stories about local folklore, beliefs, and places that were warned against venturing into. At its core, the movie is about respect for nature and the cost of ignoring that balance, told through a gripping story."
As per the latest buzz, He added, "Sidharth and Tamannaah brought so much conviction to their roles, and the entire cast and crew poured their hearts into making this world feel real."

In further updates, The movie follows Rishi (Sidharth ), who returns to his ancestral village with his wife, Mamta (Tamannaah), to sell his inherited land. However, a proposed road through a sacred forest, protected by the village deity Vandevi, draws him into a conflict between development and deeply rooted beliefs. While Mamta respects the villagers' traditions, Rishi, having lost his faith, dismisses their warnings, especially the one forbidding entry into the forest after sunset. But when he defies this age-old rule, a terrifying chain of events unfolds, drawing him into a world of unsettling mysteries and forces beyond his understanding.

On top of that, The movie is presented by Ektaa Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms Ltd. in association with TVF Motion Pictures Productions and produced under the banner of 11:11. It also stars Sunil Grover, Maniesh Paul, Shweta Tiwari and Anup Soni in pivotal roles.

Of late, on the occasion of Chhath Puja, Ektaa Kapoor revealed the movie's sequel, The Vvaan 2. The makers shared the update on social media, writing, "THE VVAAN ki kahaani abhi baaki hai (The Vvaan's story is still left)."

title: Ramayana's Lakshman, Ravie Dubey, is happy to see his line ‘tut gaya toh tut gaya’ turn into a meme, says it makes him smile
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Television star Ravie Dubey made his grand theatrical debut with Ramayana . His performance as Lakshman in the movie won praise from critics as well as audiences. One of his lines from the movie has become meme material on social media, and Ravie is more than happy about it.

Adding to this, Ravie Dubey essays the role of Lakshman in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana. Ravie Dubey on his Ramayana line becoming a meme In Ramayana: Part 1, Ravie's Lakshman says, "Tut Gaya Toh Tut Gaya (If it broke, so be it)" when Lord Parshuram gets angry and questions Lord Rama for breaking Lord Shiva's Dhanush during the Swayamvar. The line sparked a meme fest on social media.

Meanwhile, Reacting to the virality of the line, Ravie Dubey told Zoom in an interview, "I honestly had no idea it would travel this far. Sargun gets so happy seeing the memes, and what people are doing with that line really does bring a smile to my face. What makes me especially happy is that young people are finding their own way into Ramayana. For someone, it might be a line they laugh at and send to a friend. For someone else, it might be a scene that moves them. I'm happy about every way in."
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ravgun kaur ❤️ (@sr_raviidubey)

As per the latest buzz, Apart from his line becoming a meme, the star has also found a new fan base in Thailand. Thai followers have been celebrating his performance, sharing video edits of him on social media and even giving him an affectionate new name, ‘P'Ravie’. Talking about this, he shared, "I kept seeing the name Phra Lak. I looked it up and realised that's what Shri Lakshman is called in the Ramakien. I didn't know that, and it was such a lovely thing to discover through the people who were writing to me. The love has been enormous, and I'm deeply grateful for it."

In further updates, Helmed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra, the movie is a two-part epic mounted on a massive budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees. This makes it one of the most expensive and ambitious films in Indian cinema. Apart from Ranbir Kapoor, Ravie Dubey, Yash and Sai Pallavi in the lead roles, the movie also features Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Kajal Aggarwal, Adinath Kothare, Sheeba Chaddha, Indira Krishnan, Rakul Preet Singh and Vivek Oberoi, among others, in key roles.

On top of that, In just 15 days, the movie has crossed ₹ 1,500 crore rupees worldwide, surpassing the lifetime collections of blockbusters such as KGF: Chapter 2, Pathaan, Jawan, Kalki 2898 AD and Dhurandhar. Domestically, the movie has collected over ₹ 860 crore rupees and continues to attract audiences to theatres.

Riya Sharma is a content producer at Hindustan Times who lives and breathes entertainment. If there’s gossip making noise in Bollywood or a reality show moment breaking the internet, chances are she’s already writing about it. She loves digging out the juiciest stories, spotting widely shared pegs and turning it into easy-to-read content. A journalism graduate from IP University, Riya began her career as a social media executive, where she learned the art of grabbing attention in a scroll-heavy world. But her love for showbiz soon pulled her into entertainment journalism, because for her, it’s always been entertainment, entertainment and more entertainment. An artist at heart, Riya has a deep passion for acting, music and dance, which shapes how she watches and writes about films and reality shows. She loves sharing her views and reviews, especially when something excites, surprises or completely disappoints her. A hardcore reality show fan, Riya enjoys tracking every twist, task and meltdown, and breaking them down for readers who can’t get enough of high-voltage drama. Movies are equally close to her heart, whether it’s a big theatrical rollout or a binge-worthy OTT series, she’s always watching, and analysing what’s worth the time. She loves talking to celebrities, asking questions that go beyond the usual. title: Mahabharat's Lord Krishna, Nitish Bharadwaj, calls Ramayana an ‘agenda film’, slams Ravana's portrayal as a hero
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mahabharat star Nitish Bharadwaj has strongly criticised Nitesh Tiwari 's Ramayana. While the movie received largely positive reviews from critics, Nitish called out the makers for portraying Ravana as an exceptionally liberal, socially just and fair ruler, arguing that this undermines the very purpose of Lord Vishnu's avatar. He further shared that the movie "seems like an agenda movie".

Adding to this, Nitish Bharadwaj calls Ramayana an agenda movie. Nitish Bharadwaj criticises Ramayana Nitish, best known for playing Lord Krishna in BR Chopra's Mahabharat, had earlier lauded the trailer of Ramayana and predicted international success for the movie. However, the final product has disappointed him. In an interview with NDTV, Nitish objected to Lord Rama's portrayal and shared, "Lord Ram has been brought down to a minuscule, normal human being who has a deadpan face. That's not Ram. Lord Ram is about maryada."
Meanwhile, He added that the portrayal of Ram leaving Ayodhya in tears fails to reflect the Ikshvaku clan's code of honour.

Notably, Nitish further criticised the movie for showing Ravana as a hero and shared, "Ravana's negatives were not shown at all. His character comes across like a Marxist communist leader. This weakling that you showed as Lord Ram is going to kill Ravan. You are making a hero out of a villain and a villain out of a hero."

As per the latest buzz, He further argued that the younger generation, which "does not read", could spend the next two years admiring Ravana as a "cool dude". He questioned how the makers would then portray Ram defeating Ravana in Part 2. Nitish also claimed that money had come into the production company from Luxembourg, the UAE and Singapore. He compared what he described as "agenda people" to "the new British", alleging that cinema was being used to diminish Indian civilisation. He urged the government to "do the money trail" into the movie's funding.

In further updates, Nitish Bhardwaj is not the only one to criticise the movie for allegedly 'distorting facts'. Mukesh Khanna, Sunil Lahri and others have also raised objections, particularly to Sai Pallavi's portrayal of Sita as a warrior.

On top of that, Before its rollout, Ramayana: Part 1 faced criticism over Ranbir Kapoor's casting as Lord Rama and its visual effects. However, audience perception changed after the movie hit theatres. It subsequently faced criticism over Sita's portrayal as a warrior wielding a sword and fighting monsters. Despite the criticism, the movie has crossed ₹ 860 crore rupees at the domestic ticket-window and ₹ 1,500 crore rupees worldwide. It has also surpassed the lifetime collections of films such as Dhurandhar, Kalki 2898 AD, Jawan, Pathaan and KGF: Chapter 2.

Apart from Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman, the movie also stars Rakul Preet Singh, Arun Govil, Lara Dutta and Sheeba Chaddha in key roles. The movie has broken several box-office records and continues its strong run in theatres.

title: Sharad Kapoor says Josh co-star Shah Rukh Khan called him after his emotional appeal for work, reveals plan to meet Aryan Khan
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Josh-fame star Sharad Kapoor of late grabbed headlines after a video of him parting ways with his dogs went widely shared on social media. The star later shared a video appealing for work, following which several actors, including Sonu Sood, Salman Khan and others, came forward to support him during a difficult time. Now, Sharad has opened up that his Josh co-star Shah Rukh Khan has also extended his support.

Adding to this, Josh star Sharad Kapoor reveals Shah Rukh Khan called him after his widely shared video on work appeal. Shah Rukh Khan extends support to Josh co-star Sharad Kapoor In a recent chat with Navbharat Times, Sharad opened up that Shah Rukh called him after his appeal for work went widely shared on social media. The star shared, "Shah Rukh Khan shared do whatever you like and wish to do; I am ready to help you. I will be meeting Aryan Khan soon."

Meanwhile, He then recalled his fond memories of working with Shah Rukh during the shoot of Josh and shared, "We had a great bond; whenever he got stuck on some dialogue, I helped him, even if the scene was against me, because I wanted to make a good movie. And Shah Rukh is a confident star, bahut bada aadmi hai woh (he is a man of great stature)."

Notably, In the same interview, Sharad opened up that Sonu Sood had arranged a team of doctors and medical facilities to treat his leg injury. He added that he would be travelling to Karjat for treatment. Earlier, the All Indian Cine Workers Association had also lauded Salman and Sonu for helping Sharad during a difficult phase in his life.

As per the latest buzz, A video of Sharad parting ways with his four pet dogs surfaced online last week, raising concerns about his health and living conditions. The star later took to social media and shared a video revealing that he had been battling depression and had also suffered a leg injury.

In further updates, He appealed to senior actors, filmmakers and members of the movie fraternity to help him find acting opportunities. He shared he had been through a difficult period and wanted to start working again. He also spoke about how allegations against him had affected his mental health.

On top of that, He shared, "I want to appeal to CINTAA that I am looking for good work. And I need your support, and I know you have always supported people around you. A little bit of moral support is also enough for me."
He added, "I am a great star and you know that. Money is not the issue. The only issue is I am just looking forward to start work again."

title: Saif Ali Khan receives death threat in the name of Baba Siddique's alleged killers; police launch investigation
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Saif Ali Khan has become the latest high-profile individual from Hindi cinema to receive a death threat, the Mumbai Police verified on Thursday. The star allegedly received a threat in the name of Zeeshan Akhtar, a wanted accused in the murder of politician Baba Siddique . Police have launched an investigation.

Adding to this, Saif Ali Khan has received an alleged threat to his life. Saif Ali Khan receives threat The Mumbai Police told news agency PTI on Thursday that they have started an investigation into the alleged death threat received by Saif and are verifying its authenticity. “Star Saif Ali Khan received a voice message on his phone in the name of Zeeshan Akhtar, stating that he would meet the same fate as Baba Siddique,” a police official was quoted as saying.

Meanwhile, The report added that police are currently investigating whether the threat genuinely originated from Akhtar or someone else is impersonating him and using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to harass celebrities.

Notably, In October 2024, Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) leader and former Maharashtra minister Baba Siddique was shot dead by three assailants outside his son Zeeshan Siddique's office in Mumbai's Bandra East area.

As per the latest buzz, The alleged threat to Saif's life is the latest in a series of threats made to movie stars, including Amitabh Bachchan , Ayushmann Khurrana and Tusshar Kapoor, in recent weeks. Alongside the personal threats to actors, superstar Amitabh Bachchan's Juhu residence, Jalsa, was repeatedly named in a series of hoax bomb warnings sent to authorities in Mumbai and Pune over the past month.

In further updates, In October, an email sent to Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde and Deputy Mayor Sanjay Ghadi warned off an attack on Amitabh's bungalow and singer Diljit Dosanjh's concert at the Mahalaxmi Racecourse on November 27. Following this, Amitabh Bachchan conducted his weekly meet and greet with followers cased in bulletproof glass.

On top of that, The Mumbai Police of late cracked the case involving threats to movie stars like Ayushmann Khurrana and Tusshar Kapoor, concluding that a Bengaluru-based IIT graduate with no link to any gang was behind them. The police arrested 30-year-old Vaibhav Mishra, saying he used AI to issue threats. His motive remains unclear.

This is not the first time Saif has been in the news this year in connection to a threat to his life. In January, the star was stabbed by an intruder inside his home in Bandra. Saif, 55, was hospitalised and had to undergo surgery to remove the knife fragments from his body. The accused was arrested by the Mumbai police after a few days.

title: Sameera Reddy says South cinema gave her far more respect, money and stardom than Bollywood | Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sameera Reddy stepped away from films for several years to focus on raising her two children in Goa. She of late made her comeback with Sanjay Dutt's Aakhri Sawal , but thanks to her candid and relatable presence on social media, it feels like she has never really been away.

Adding to this, Sameera Reddy fondly remembered her stint in South Indian cinema. In a conversation with Hindustan Times, the star opened up about returning to films and how Sanjay accommodated her schedule, allowing her to shoot over weekends so she could be with her children during the week. She also shared her take on the debate around working hours for new mothers, and reflected on why her experience in South Indian cinema has been far more rewarding than her stint in Bollywood. Read on:

Meanwhile, It was wonderful. Having done two or three films with Sanjay earlier, reuniting felt very comfortable. Sanjay also produced this movie and he was extremely sweet. The main reason I haven’t done feature films or OTT projects over the past few years is that I am a very hands-on mother living in Goa. My life from morning to night revolves around my kids, and I found it very hard to leave them for weeks to shoot on set. But Sanjay accommodated me by suggesting, “Just come and shoot on the weekends.” Because of that arrangement, I shot every weekend over two to three months and loved every bit of it.

Notably, When I shot for Sanjay’s movie, I shot continuously and didn’t mind the long hours or extra shifts at all because I wanted to finish the work efficiently for my producer, especially since I don’t live in Mumbai. But I have done extra shifts when the need of the hour.

As per the latest buzz, That being shared, being a new mother comes with immense pressure — managing breastfeeding, hormonal changes and work simultaneously is not easy. If a producer can adjust and accommodate that star...it is a two way street. But if it doesn't work for the producer than everybody has to understand it. Looking at it from a producer’s perspective, massive daily financial investments are riding on a movie set, and delays can be very costly.

In further updates, Both sides of the situation need to be recognized and respected. While I cannot comment directly on Deepika Padukone’s specific stance, but I understand, she is an amazing star and if that was she needs, that is what she needs. But you can't have a one-sided view on this.

On top of that, To be completely honest, I had a superb experience in South Indian cinema. I worked with top stars including Chiranjeevi, Jr NTR, Suriya, Ajith, and Mohanlal, and my personal experiences were wonderful. Everyone’s journey is different, but for me, my Southern movie experience was way above my experience in Bollywood.

The respect, artistic value, financial compensation, and stardom I received in the South far surpassed what I experienced in Hindi cinema. Even today, 18 years later, the love and respect I receive from my Southern followers is unprecedented. While a Bollywood fan might say, “Oh yeah, there was a Sameera Reddy,” followers in the South still greet me warmly, saying, “We love you. You are our Meghna from Vaaranam Aayiram!” I will always hold the softest corner in my heart for my South Indian films, and in my mind, I will always consider myself a South Indian star first.

title: Mahaveer Jain announces epic musical drama Kabira on Sant Kabir; Abhishek Sharma to direct, Tanishk Bagchi to compose
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Set in 15th-century Kashi, the movie will explore the mystic poet’s life, philosophy and challenge to religious and social divisions.

Adding to this, Set against the backdrop of 15th-century Kashi, Kabira will trace the life of a figure whose philosophy centred on humanity and spiritual unity. Born to a Hindu mother and raised by a Muslim weaver family, Kabir's journey was shaped by his position outside the established religious structures of his time. His life and poetry questioned divisions between communities, with his teachings continuing to find relevance across generations.

Meanwhile, The movie will be directed by Abhishek Sharma, known for helming projects such as Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran and Tere Bin Laden . With Kashi forming an important part of the narrative, the filmmaker will look to recreate the historical setting and bring the city's ghats and cultural atmosphere to the big screen.

Notably, Music will be a key element of the project, with composer Tanishk Bagchi developing its musical landscape. Kabir's celebrated dohas and spiritual philosophy will be reinterpreted through a blend of folk, Sufi and classical fusion sounds. The makers are positioning the movie as a musical experience that brings together the poet's timeless words and a contemporary cinematic presentation.

As per the latest buzz, Kabira is presented by Mahaveer Jain and Amit Upadhyay and produced by Mahaveer Jain Films (MJF), Saral Vallabh Bhansali and Shraddha Singh under the banner of A Shock and Awe Production.

In further updates, While the makers have not yet revealed details about the principal cast, the project is scheduled to go on floors in early 2027. With its focus on Kabir's life, social philosophy and poetry, the movie aims to bring a significant chapter of India's cultural and spiritual history to theatrical audiences.

title: MEGA EXCLUSIVE: Mumbai's iconic Gaiety-Galaxy FINALLY reopens after 74 days, just 4 days before its 54th anniversary; full film schedule for the week REVEALED
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

This big breaking news was verified to Bollywood Hungama by Digvijay Jinde, who runs the hugely popular YouTube channel Bollywood Premee. He told us, “The good news is that the theatre finally resumes operations from November 20. The plans for tomorrow have already been drawn and advance booking has begun.”

Adding to this, Digvijay was overjoyed and even had tears of happiness when he informed us about this development. And it's hardly surprising. After all, for countless moviegoers, the temporary shutdown of Gaiety-Galaxy was nothing short of a heartbreak. For them, G7 is not just another cinema complex. It is a part of Mumbai's cinematic history, a place where films are not merely watched but truly celebrated.

Meanwhile, Digvijay also shared with us the list of films that will be screened at G7 from November 20. The biggest auditorium, Gaiety, will screen Ramayana at 1:00 pm, 5:00 pm and 9:15 pm. Galaxy will play the Hindi version of OM: Operation Mole at 11:45 am, 3:00 pm, 6:15 pm and 9:30 pm. In Gemini, Rajini: The Jailer 2 will be screened at 12:00 pm, 3:15 pm, 6:30 pm and 9:45 pm.
Notably, In the 100-seater Gossip, Kaali Kheti is scheduled for 12:45 pm, while Drishyam The Conclusion will be shown at 3:45 pm, 6:45 pm and 9:45 pm.

As per the latest buzz, In Gem, Nanhe Dil , Jijai (Marathi flick), Kaali Kheti, Obsess and Udta Teer will be screened at 12:30 pm, 2:45 pm, 5:00 pm, 7:15 pm and 10:00 pm, respectively. Finally, in Glamour, The Vvaan will be screened at 12:15 pm, followed by Bandhu (Marathi flick) at 3:00 pm, Maitreyaa (Marathi flick) at 6:15 pm and Party Animals at 9:30 pm.

In further updates, Gaiety-Galaxy's closure lasted a staggering 74 days, and one can only imagine the financial losses suffered by the management during this period. Bollywood Hungama had earlier reported that despite the shutdown, executive director Manoj Desai continued to pay salaries to the employees, ensuring that they did not suffer financially due to the closure.

On top of that, Interestingly, Gaiety-Galaxy was inaugurated on November 24, 1972. In other words, the legendary cinema complex is reopening just four days before its 54th anniversary. For a theatre that has witnessed some of the biggest celebrations in Hindi cinema over more than five decades, the timing couldn't have been more special.

title: Ramayana box office collection day 15: Yash has a new winner in hand as film with Ranbir Kapoor takes over KGF Chapter 2 haul at ₹861 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana: Part 1 was rolled out in theatres on November 5 to mixed reviews but has performed exceptionally well at the ticket-window. The movie starring Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Yash has now overtaken the lifetime collections of the Kannada star’s previous biggest hit, KGF: Chapter 2. The movie has crossed the ₹ 860 crore rupees mark in India alone.

Adding to this, Yash plays Ravana in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Part 1. Ramayana ticket-window earnings The trade website Sacnilk reported a collection of ₹ 16.72 crore rupees net in India for Ramayana on Thursday, taking its domestic total to ₹ 861.12 crore rupees. This means that the movie based on the Indian epic has surpassed the lifetime haul of Yash’s previous smash hit, KGF: Chapter 2, which stands at ₹ 859.70 crore rupees.

Meanwhile, Ramayana collected ₹ 564.50 crore rupees in net ticket-window in India in its first week. It collected ₹ 48.10 crore rupees on its second Friday, and ₹ 72.90 crore rupees and ₹ 75 crore rupees on Saturday and Sunday, respectively. On Monday, the movie brought in ₹ 32 crore rupees, with ₹ 28.60 crore rupees on Tuesday and ₹ 23.20 crore rupees on Wednesday. It has performed better in Hindi than the dubbed languages.

Notably, Ramayana has already surpassed the lifetime hauls of Aditya Dhar’s Ranveer Singh-starrer Dhurandhar , Laxman Utekar’s Vicky Kaushal-starrer Chhaava and more. It has films such as Dhurandhar: The Revenge, Pushpa 2: The Rule, Baahubali 2: The Conclusion and Dangal to contend with.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by The World Of Ramayana (@worldoframayana)

In further updates, Ravi Dubey , who played Lakshman in Ramayana, penned a heartfelt note on the response to the movie. “On the morning of 5th November 2026, I woke up and felt something I’d forgotten the feeling of. I felt ‘seen’, and the love in it felt infinite. I think that’s all an star truly wants. That someone gives your work a chance. That something you felt while doing it reaches someone else, and they feel enough to tell you about it. What a gift that is. I’m still in disbelief as I write this. All I feel is gratitude,” he wrote on his Instagram account.

On top of that, Ramayana is directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan, and produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash. It stars Ranbir as Rama, Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta also star in it, with Anupam Kher voicing Jatayu. Part 2 of Ramayana was initially revealed to hit screens for Diwali 2027, but it has been postponed to 2028.

title: Aryan Khan calls Shah Rukh Khan a ‘beast’, says he takes comparisons with father as a compliment
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Being compared to his father, Shah Rukh Khan , was perhaps inevitable for Aryan Khan . While he acknowledges the comparisons, the filmmaker is also working to carve out his own identity and make a mark in the Hindi movie industry. His successful directorial debut, The Ba***ds of Bollywood , was a significant step in that direction.

Adding to this, Aryan Khan spoke about being compared to father Shah Rukh Khan. Aryan on being compared to Shah Rukh Khan Aryan has now been named to the inaugural TIME100 Next India list, unveiled on November 19. He features on one of the list's covers alongside fellow filmmakers Payal Kapadia and Theja Rio.

Meanwhile, During his interview with the magazine, Aryan was asked how he feels about being compared to his father. The filmmaker shared he takes the comparisons as a compliment. “Everyone has been compared to him. It’s fine if I'm one of the people. I take it as a compliment to be compared to the number one guy. He’s a beast,” he shared.

Notably, During the interaction, Aryan also recalled how Salman Khan's cameo in The Ba***ds of Bollywood came about. He shared that while shooting for the show, he learnt that Salman was at the same location. Aryan sent a message to the star's team to ask if he could come over and meet him. However, Salman instead offered to visit Aryan's set himself.

As per the latest buzz, On learning that Salman was on his way, Aryan asked his cinematographer to keep a shot ready. When the star arrived and promptly asked, “What's the position?”, Aryan gave him an improvised line and pointed him towards the camera. The moment became one of the show's most memorable scenes. Speaking about his approach to filmmaking, Aryan shared, “I am good at bringing ideas to life, from getting them down on paper to seeing things through to execution.”

In further updates, The Ba***ds of Bollywood marked Aryan's directorial debut. The seven-episode Netflix series follows Aasmaan Singh, an ambitious newcomer navigating the unpredictable world of Bollywood, along with his best friend Parvaiz and manager Sanya. The show features Lakshya, Sahher Bambba, Raghav Juyal, Bobby Deol, Anya Singh, Mona Singh, Manoj Pahwa and Rajat Bedi, among others. It premiered on Netflix in 2025 and was bankrolled by Shah Rukh Khan and Gauri Khan's production house, Red Chillies Entertainment.

On top of that, Meanwhile, Shah Rukh Khan is gearing up for the rollout of his soon-to-release movie, King. Directed by Siddharth Anand, the action thriller also stars Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji and Jaideep Ahlawat.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The recent firing incident targeting Tiger Shroff’s car in Mumbai’s Juhu area has further heightened concerns about the safety of Bollywood celebrities. Several actors have as per reports approached the authorities, seeking protection in view of the developments.

Adding to this, According to sources in the Security and Protection Branch of Mumbai Police, the applications are currently under scrutiny. A police officer as per reports shared that X-category security is one of the options being considered. Before taking a decision, the authorities will assess the nature of the threats, verify their credibility and evaluate the potential risks faced by each individual. The level of protection will be determined based on these assessments.
Meanwhile, Ayushmann Khurrana, Amitabh Bachchan and other actors as per reports receive threats

Notably, Ayushmann Khurrana had as per reports received a threat, following which Bengaluru-based IT professional Vaibhav Mishra was arrested. As per the latest buzz, The firing incident involving Tiger Shroff's car has also brought the issue of star security into focus. Other Bollywood actors who have as per reports received threats include Akshay Kumar, Ranveer Singh, Tusshar Kapoor and Aamir Khan.

The names being looked into include Babbar Khalsa-linked elements, Anil Pandit, Harry Boxer and Goldy Dhillon. However, investigations into their alleged connections and possible roles are still underway.

On top of that, X-category security generally involves two armed security personnel being assigned to protect an individual. However, the actual security arrangement can vary depending on the threat assessment and recommendations made by the concerned security agencies.

For now, Mumbai Police is reviewing the applications submitted by the actors and assessing their individual security requirements. The authorities will decide whether additional protection is necessary and determine the appropriate level of security based on the findings.

title: Imtiaz Ali says audience's watching pattern is unquantifiable today, they will watch both Ramayana and Pyre: HT Leadership Summit 2026
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

At the of late held Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026, filmmaker Imtiaz Ali and star Ananya Panday discussed their work and the future of the movie industry. While discussing the audience’s viewing patterns with HT's Sonal Kalra, Imtiaz mentioned that both big-ticket films like Ramayana and independent films like Pyre have a space in theatres now.

Adding to this, At the HT Leadership Summit 2026, Imtiaz Ali brought up Ramayana and Pyre as examples. Imtiaz Ali on Ramayana-Pyre in theatres At the summit, Imtiaz called the audience viewing pattern unquantifiable and shared, “The audience is not telling us that this is the kind of pattern they like. It is so simple, yet so unquantifiable, that it cannot be put into a pattern. The same people who are watching Ramayana also want to watch Pyre. When footfalls for Ramayana increase, smaller films will also get a chance.”

Meanwhile, The director also mentioned that the movie industry is going through introspection, stating, “All of us in the movie industry are thinking what will work. The language might change, but at the crux of it, we want to hear good stories. And we want to ask ourselves, what is the story which I can tell, and tell that. It’s a phase of introspection that the movie industry is going through. The movie industry is also breaking its pattern.”

Notably, At the summit, Imtiaz also shared that they are in a delicious phase where people say that nothing is working and don’t know what movie will work at the ticket-window. And irrespective of the supposed missing attention span in the audience, it is 3-hour-long films such as Dhurandhar that take the cake.

As per the latest buzz, This comes after Pyre director Vinod Kapri previously complained about the dropped screens for his independent movie amid the rollout of Nitesh Tiwari’s Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash-starrer Ramayana. The movie was initially screened on 400 screens after its October 30 rollout, but that number dropped to fewer than 100 after Ramayana’s November 5 rollout. The director alleged that theatres removed his movie despite houseful shows and appealed for fairness. The All India Cine Workers Association backed his demand.

In further updates, Vinod took to social media on November 11 to express his gratitude to the audience for their support. He opened up that 200 shows for the movie were added starting November 13. He also thanked exhibitors and cinema chains for backing the movie. Made on a reported budget of ₹ 2.5 crore rupees, Pyre initially opened with around 80 shows, but positive word of mouth helped it gain momentum. title: Aamir Khan leases three luxury apartments in Mumbai's Santacruz for ₹38 lakh monthly rent
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Aamir Khan has leased three luxury residential apartments at Seasons Trimurti in Santacruz (West), Mumbai, for a combined monthly rent of ₹ 38 lakh over a four-year tenure, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.

Adding to this, Aamir Khan has leased three luxury residential apartments at Seasons Trimurti in Santacruz (West), Mumbai, for a combined monthly rent of ₹38 lakh over a four-year tenure (Photo for representational purposes only) The leave and licence agreements, signed between Seasons Avenues Properties and Aamir Husain Khan, cover three apartments on the 14th, 12th and 11th floors, measuring 6,200 sq ft, 3,000 sq ft and 3,000 sq ft, respectively. The three apartments have a combined carpet area of 12,200 sq ft and are located on North Avenue in Santacruz (West).

Meanwhile, The largest apartment commands a monthly rent of ₹ 20 lakh, while the other two apartments have monthly rents of ₹ 9 lakh each. The combined monthly rental outgo is ₹ 38 lakh. Each apartment comes with three car parking spaces, taking the total to nine, the documents showed.

Notably, The agreements have a tenure of 48 months, commencing on January 1, 2027, and ending on December 31, 2030. The rent will increase by 5% annually. The combined security deposit is ₹ 38 lakh, equivalent to one month's rent. At the initial monthly rental, the annual outgo works out to ₹ 4.56 crore rupees, the leave and licence agreement showed.

As per the latest buzz, Society maintenance, water charges and existing and future property and municipal taxes are included in the monthly rent and will be borne by the licensor. The agreements also prohibit the tenant from making structural alterations or permanent additions to the apartments.
In further updates, The star and the developer could not be reached for a comment.

On top of that, In 2025, Khan leased four apartments in Mumbai's Pali Hill neighbourhood for a combined monthly rent of ₹ 24.5 lakh. The apartments are located in Wilnomona Apartments on Nargis Dutt Road. The five-year lease, registered in May 2025, runs until May 2030 and carries a 45-month lock-in period. The security deposit was reported to be over ₹ 1.46 crore rupees, with a 5% annual rent escalation.

Khan's move to rented accommodation in Pali Hill in 2025 was linked to the redevelopment of Virgo Cooperative Housing Society in Bandra , where he as per reports owns around 12 apartments. The redevelopment is being undertaken by Atmosphere Realty, a joint venture involving Wadhwa Group, Man Infraconstruction and Chandak Group.

title: Lara Dutta says she had no apprehensions about playing Ranbir Kapoor's stepmother in Ramayana despite 4-year age gap
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Lara Dutta plays Kaikeyi, Lord Ram's stepmother, in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana . The 48-year-old star of late opened up about playing the mother of Ranbir Kapoor , who is just four years younger than her. She shared she was not apprehensive about the age gap and described the idea of actors worrying about such roles as outdated. Lara also plays the mother of Addinath M Kothare, 42, in the movie. Addinath plays the role of Kaikeyi's son Bharat in the movie.

Adding to this, Lara Dutta spoke about playing Ranbir Kapoor's stepmother in Ramayana. Lara Dutta on playing Ranbir Kapoor's stepmother in Ramayana In an interview with News18, Lara shared she had no reservations about playing these roles despite the small age difference between her and the actors. She told News18, “100 percent not! I think we’re all beyond all of this. Today, as actors, no one is stuck in these outdated thinking of, ‘Oh, I’m a female star. How will I play so and so character?’ Today, you’re embodying characters. There was no ounce or iota of such thoughts."

Meanwhile, Lara also explained that the story had to be viewed in its larger context, pointing out that King Dasharath had three queens and Kaikeyi was the youngest among his queens. She shared, “And when you look at the larger scheme of things, Dashrath had three queens. They were all of different ages and areas. To play Kaikeyi, the first thing that Nitesh sir and I did was to sit down and flesh out the entire history of the character – the parts that you don’t even see onscreen, why she asked for those two boons, where those boons were promised, who she was and where she came from."

Notably, Lara also spoke about how an opportunity to play a character like Kaikeyi comes rarely in an star's career and should be grabbed with both hands. She also recalled playing former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi in Akshay Kumar's BellBottom, calling it an opportunity of a lifetime to portray a character so iconic and timeless.
As per the latest buzz, The two-part epic is produced by Namit Malhotra. The first instalment rolled out in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part slated for a Diwali 2028 rollout.

title: Alia Bhatt backs Deepika Padukone's 8-hour work shift demand, calls for better facilities and clean toilets for women on sets
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Deepika Padukone 's reported exits from Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit and Kalki 2898 AD Part 2 over her reported demand for an eight-hour workday sparked a discussion about work-life balance for actors and technicians. Several actors, including Neha Dhupia , Kareena Kapoor, Ananya Panday and others, backed her. Now, Alia Bhatt has also supported Deepika's demand and revealed what else she believes needs to change in the industry.

Adding to this, Alia Bhatt backs Deepika Padukone's 8-hour work shift demand. Alia Bhatt backs Deepika Padukone's 8-hour shift demand Alia featured on the cover of TIME magazine's TIME100 Next India list. In an interview with the magazine, Alia opened up that she stands firmly with Deepika, who of late sparked a debate over Bollywood's culture of long working hours. She shared, "I’ve been lucky that all my producers have been extremely accommodating, but this needs a rethink. It cannot be arbitrary. Fair working hours make the work more efficient, and people shouldn’t be afraid of losing employment when they set those boundaries."

Meanwhile, Alia opened up that there's another reform she wants to bring to her sets: clean toilets for female artistes. She shared, “It’s not really asking for the sun and the moon but something so basic, so essential. A woman being able to use a clean bathroom on a movie set should not be a conversation in 2026. I want to ensure—on a systemic level—that this becomes a norm for the entire crew and not just the top talent.”

Notably, The TIME100 Next India list recognises emerging leaders whose work, ideas and vision are shaping the country's future. The list also features Vedang Raina, Parvathy Thiruvothu, Vicky Kaushal, Payal Kapadia, Aryan Khan, Faheem Abdullah, Anirudh Ravichander, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Kani Kusruti, among others.

As per the latest buzz, Bollywood star Deepika Padukone sparked a major debate in the Hindi movie industry in 2025 after reports emerged that she had requested an eight-hour workday for her soon-to-release projects after embracing motherhood. The issue came into focus following reports of her exit from Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit, starring Prabhas, and later Kalki 2898 AD Part 2.

In further updates, Deepika later defended her stance, pointing out that several male superstars had been following eight-hour shifts for years without facing any questions. She also highlighted the unorganised nature of the movie industry and called for better working conditions for everyone, including crew members.

On top of that, Alia will next be seen in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War. The movie marks her second collaboration with the filmmaker and also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Vicky Kaushal in lead roles. It is scheduled to rollout in theatres in January 2027.

Raghav Juyal, Arshad Warsi, Rani Mukerji, Jaideep Ahlawat and others are also part of the ensemble cast. The movie is scheduled to rollout in theatres on December 24, 2026.

title: Sooraj Barjatya praises Dhurandhar, but says audiences also need family entertainers like Yeh Prem Mol Liya
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar has set a new benchmark for Hindi films at the ticket-window. However, filmmaker Sooraj Barjatya believes there is room for different kinds of cinema, including family entertainers, a genre he excels in. In a recent interaction, the director, who is currently busy promoting his soon-to-release movie Yeh Prem Mol Liya, lauded the success of Dhurandhar, but also insisted that audiences also want films like his soon-to-release movie.

Adding to this, Sooraj Barjatya called Dhurandhar 'a wonderful movie'. (PTI) 'Dhurandhar is a wonderful movie' In conversation with SCREEN, Sooraj spoke about his movie in the context of the benchmark set by Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar. He shared, “Every movie has its place. Dhurandhar is good in its way. It’s a wonderful movie. But the audience also need a movie like this, alongside Dhurandhar.”

Meanwhile, Sooraj also shared that he does not let box-office collections dictate his approach to filmmaking. Instead, he focuses on making entertaining films that audiences can enjoy together. He shared, “I have always been taught not to get bothered by a movie’s collection. And to make an entertaining movie because people spend their Diwali bonus on it. Young filmmakers have taught me to have confidence in this profession. If one movie doesn’t work, the other will. It is the story that works and not the maker. As a young filmmaker, I looked at making a number 1 movie, but at 61, I don’t have that fear. I am more free today. I would like the movie to resonate well. I would want the audiences to come to theatres and see the movie with family.”

Notably, Directed by Sooraj Barjatya, Yeh Prem Mol Liya stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari in the lead roles. The movie also features Anupam Kher, Seema Pahwa, Supriya Pathak, Saumya Tandon and Swanand Kirkire, among others. title: Sharad Kapoor hadn’t bathed or stepped out of bed for two years, his brother refused to help him, reveals Hema Chaudhary; says, “He kept dying gradually”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Hema, who runs a dog rescue organisation called Bezubaan Trust, recalled that she came across Sharad while rescuing dogs in the building where he lived in Mumbai. She shared that the star was in a concerning condition and had been largely neglected. According to her, Sharad had not bathed or even stepped out of his bed for nearly two years.

Adding to this, Sharing details about her interaction with his family, Hema shared, “He may have stopped getting work by then. When I talked to his brother, he shared the star had visited him to get their younger brother. When I tried to call his brother again, he didn’t entertain me. I told him, ‘He needs you.’ He didn’t call me back. So, maybe he’s not interested. Maybe it’s a property issue or something else.”

Meanwhile, She further spoke about how close Sharad was to losing his life before she came across him. “Three to four people have been waiting to see him die. And he was almost done 99%, but it was the dogs who led me to him. I always listen to the voiceless. When I rescued the dogs, I met him. He hadn’t bathed or gotten out of bed for two years. Nobody had called him or asked if he’d had food, so he kept dying gradually,” she shared.

Notably, Hema also spoke about Sharad's personal life and his family situation. She verified that the star was engaged to Koel Basu, granddaughter of former West Bengal Chief Minister Jyoti Basu, but the two never got married. She also opened up that Sharad has a girlfriend but claimed that she is not in a position to take care of him. Addressing rumours about the star having a child, Hema shared she did not have his permission to confirm the information. She added that Sharad had asked her to disclose details about his personal life when the time was right.
As per the latest buzz, Hema Chaudhary addresses rumours about Sharad Kapoor's Hollywood debut

In further updates, Hema also addressed reports suggesting that Sharad had signed a Hollywood project. Questioning these claims, she shared that the star was not mentally stable at present and needed assistance before considering any professional commitments. She suggested that some of his statements to the media could be connected to his current mental state. However, she clarified that Sharad was not “fake” and needed support to recover before taking up projects, whether in Bollywood or elsewhere.

On top of that, Sharad of late came into the spotlight after Hema shared videos documenting his living conditions and appealed to the movie industry to help him find work. The star had also requested employment to address his ongoing financial difficulties. Actors Salman Khan and Sonu Sood as per reports reached out to offer assistance, with Sonu even visiting Sharad personally.

However, Hema alleged that some people had taken advantage of the star's vulnerable situation by giving him money, clicking photographs with him and subsequently taking the money back. She also criticised individuals allegedly using Sharad's name to collect donations through fake online campaigns.

title: Sai Pallavi reveals her grandfather’s reaction to her portrayal of Sita, says he thinks ‘God acted through her’ in Ramayana
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sai Pallavi has been receiving praise for her portrayal of Sita in Ramayana . While followers have lauded her performance, a video of her grandfather reacting to her role in the movie has also been doing the rounds on social media. In the clip, he appears to say that Sai Pallavi did not act in Ramayana. The star has now clarified what he meant, revealing the complete context behind his statement.

Adding to this, Sai Pallavi spoke about her grandfather praising her performance in Ramayana. (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello) (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello) Sai Pallavi clarifies grandfather's comment on her role as Sita In an interview with Behindwoods, Pallavi addressed the video in which her grandfather was heard saying, “Sai Pallavi did not act in Ramayana.” She explained that the clip had been cut short, leaving out the context of his statement. Revealing what he had actually shared, the star clarified, “But actually he replied, 'I don't think she acted, I think it was God only has acted through her'.”

Meanwhile, In an earlier interview with BritAsia TV, Pallavi spoke about growing up in a family where her grandparents would often refer to her and the other children as gods and goddesses. She shared, “I grew up in a household where my grandparents would call us gods and goddesses. So when we did something wrong, they would say, 'You are a goddess, you should not do this.' That is a lot of added pressure.”

Notably, Recalling how her grandparents reacted when she was offered the role of Sita, Pallavi shared they were among the first people she shared the news with. “But when I was offered the role, the first people I told about this was my grandparents. They were really happy,” she added.

As per the latest buzz, Pallavi has also spoken about why playing a goddess is not an easy task. At a promotional event for the movie in July, she shared, “It’s not easy for actors to get roles like this. Because it’s not easy to play a Goddess. There must be a team putting their heart and soul into making it the best version. I don’t think I chose to play Sita maa. I was blessed to play this role. It’s not something that you can go after and not something you can write down and say, this is how I want to play. I would sit and meditate and say, Sita maa, you act through me. Whatever comes through me is what you want for the movie.”

title: Ramayana worldwide box office collection day 14: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film is the fastest to ₹1500 crore; beats Dhurandhar 2, Baahubali 2, Pushpa 2
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

It’s another day and another milestone for Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana . Despite losing some of the festive momentum at the ticket-window, the movie continues to break records and reach milestones each day. Two weeks after its rollout, Ramayana has crossed the ₹ 1500-crore rupees mark, becoming the fastest Indian movie to reach the milestone on the back of an impressive overseas performance.

Adding to this, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama and Yash as Ravana. Ramayana worldwide ticket-window update The Ranbir Kapoor and Yash -starrer had seven consecutive days when it grossed over ₹ 100 crore rupees worldwide. There was a revival on its second weekend before the inevitable drop. On Wednesday, the movie fell below ₹ 50 crore rupees in single-day gross for the first time since its rollout, bringing in only ₹ 37 crore rupees.

Meanwhile, On Wednesday, Ramayana collected ₹ 23 crore rupees net in India, its lowest single-day haul since its rollout. However, this was enough to take the movie’s domestic haul to ₹ 844 crore rupees net ( ₹ 1008 crore rupees gross). On Wednesday, Ramayana became the second-highest-grossing Hindi movie in India, eclipsing Dhurandhar and trailing only its sequel, Dhurandhar: The Revenge.

Notably, Overseas, Ramayana turned over a new leaf after a subpar start. Thanks to a solid showing in the US and in niche markets like Thailand, Vietnam, and Nepal, Ramayana actually maintained its overseas run even at the end of the second week. On day 14, the movie collected less than $1 million in a day for the first time. However, this was enough to take its overseas gross to $54 million. As a result, Ramayana has now collected ₹ 1519 crore rupees worldwide after 14 days. It is only the fifth Indian movie to cross the ₹ 1500-crore rupees threshold.

As per the latest buzz, Ramayana reached the ₹ 1500-crore rupees mark in 14 days flat. This is the fastest an Indian movie has reached the milestone. The Namit Malhotra production broke the record of Aditya Dhar’s Dhurandhar 2, which reached the threshold in 15 days earlier this year. Pushpa 2: The Rule took 18 days to cross ₹ 1500 crore rupees in 2024, while SS Rajamouli’s Baahubali 2 did so in 18 days.

In further updates, The way Ramayana is going, both domestically and internationally, makers would hope that it can make a beeline for the ₹ 2000-crore rupees mark. Aamir Khan’s Dangal is the only Indian movie in the 2000-crore rupees club.

On top of that, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is the first of a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The first part is running in theatres, while the second part is set for a Diwali 2028 rollout.

title: Javed Akhtar says people with no understanding of music dictate terms to songwriters and composers, quips makers think ‘they know it all’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran lyricist and screenwriter Javed Akhtar has criticised the growing interference of producers and music companies in the creative process of movie music, saying that people with no understanding of music are now advising on how songs should be written and made.

Adding to this, Javed Akhtar has opened up on producers' interference in songwriting. Javed Akhtar on the interference in music On Wednesday, the veteran lyricist and writer attended the launch of the Indian Performing Right Society's (IPRS) EY Music Creator Report in Mumbai. Speaking about giving creators freedom within movie projects, he touched upon producers' growing interference in soundtracks.

Meanwhile, "Somewhere we've moved away from the purpose. The problem is the tail is wagging the dog; that should not happen. There's too much interference, conditions. When a writer writes lyrics, they can do 100 times better work, but they are not allowed to do so. Songwriters like Irshad Kamil and others are talented, but do you allow them to write good songs?" he asked.

Notably, Recalling a personal instance of interference, Akhtar shared an executive once objected to his use of the word 'roothna' in a song. The writer added that people with no understanding of music often dictate terms to songwriters and composers. “Writing and music are things that everybody thinks, 'I understand it', but they don't understand so many other things, like physics, chemistry, geology, but about music and writing they know it all. Like, they know what good writing is about, how to write, how not to write, what the right word is,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, According to the (IPRS) EY report, India's music creator economy generated an estimated ₹ 17,400 crore rupees in 2025, registering a 45 per cent increase since 2023. The sound recording and publishing revenues in 2025 reached Rs. 5,433 crore rupees, an all-time high. Besides, the annual releases of original songs increased from 22,000 to 27,000 in 2025.

In further updates, At the launch of the report, Javed Akhtar also called for stronger implementation of copyright laws amid technological changes, including the growing use of artificial intelligence. The writer opened up that he and music composer-singer Shankar Mahadevan plan to hold an event next month via their company, Goongoonalo, which is India's first artist-owned and artist-led music platform and creative studio.

title: Alia Bhatt calls assumptions about ‘unequal marriage’ with Ranbir Kapoor offensive, says she feels seen and heard in their relationship
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

Bollywood actors Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor tied the knot in an intimate wedding ceremony in 2022. Their marriage has frequently become a subject of debate on social media, with followers dissecting their public appearances and interviews and coming up with elaborate theories about Alia being ‘a victim of an unequal marriage’. Now, Alia has dismissed such suggestions made by strangers.

Adding to this, Alia Bhatt reacts to speculations around her marriage with Ranbir Kapoor. Alia Bhatt slams constant speculations about her marriage In a conversation with TIME magazine for its TIME100 Next India list, Alia spoke about the constant speculation surrounding her relationship with Ranbir. She shared, "I am someone who’s always advocating for women to know their mind, to know their heart, so to reduce me to someone who’d suffer through this imagined scenario is offensive.”

Meanwhile, Alia added that she believes these comments continue because her relationship does not fit traditional ideas about marriage. “The bedrock of any relationship is when you feel seen without putting any effort, and feel heard without saying anything—that’s Ranbir for me, and that’s our reality.”

Notably, Alia and Ranbir got married in 2022 after dating for a few years. The couple welcomed their daughter, Raha, later that year. Speculation about the dynamics of their relationship gained momentum in May 2023, when Alia shared that Ranbir disliked it when she raised her voice during arguments. In an interview, she shared she tried to control her anger because her husband believed it was important to remain kind even when unhappy. Her remark prompted several social media users to question whether she was constantly adjusting her behaviour to please him.

As per the latest buzz, The discussion intensified in August 2023 when Alia appeared in a Vogue India interview and opened up that Ranbir would ask her to wipe off her lipstick because he preferred her natural lip colour. While she shared it as a casual anecdote, several users called his behaviour controlling and labelled him a red flag. The backlash became significant enough that Alia addressed it during her appearance on Koffee With Karan 8 in November 2023. Defending Ranbir, she shared his remarks had been taken out of context and that he was nothing like what social media portrayed him as.

In further updates, In July 2024, another remark by Ranbir fuelled the debate. During a conversation on Nikhil Kamath's podcast, he shared that people in a marriage need to let go of certain aspects of their personalities and adjust to each other. He also spoke about Alia changing her loud tone after marriage to make him feel more comfortable. Over time, even short clips of the couple's public appearances and interactions at events became subjects of online analysis, with some social media users claiming that Alia appeared unhappy around Ranbir.

On top of that, Alia is all set to share the screen with Ranbir in Love & War. The movie will mark their second on-screen collaboration after Brahmastra. Directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali, it also stars Vicky Kaushal in the lead. The movie is scheduled to rollout in theatres in January 2027.

title: Auto, taxi drivers to protest at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan today over fare revision, EV policy, bike-taxi services
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Transport workers from across India are set to gather at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan on November 19, to protest against government policies and seek action on their long-pending demands. The demonstration, organised by the Bharatiya Private Transport Mazdoor Mahasangh, which is affiliated with the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh, will begin at 11 am.

Adding to this, The protest will bring together drivers of autos, taxis, buses, trucks, ambulances and e-rickshaws. (Unsplash, representational image ) The protest will bring together drivers of autos, taxis, buses, trucks, ambulances and e-rickshaws. The union shared hundreds of workers were expected to participate and raise issues they believe have not been addressed by the central government, state governments and the Delhi government.
Meanwhile, The organisation has described the policies of these governments as “wrong policies”.

Notably, Yogesh Sharma, national president of the Bharatiya Private Transport Mazdoor Mahasangh, and former general secretary Rajendra Soni alleged that governments had failed to deliver on commitments made to transport workers after assuming office.

As per the latest buzz, They shared the BJP government had been in power in Delhi for over a year and a half but had yet to fulfil any of the promises made to auto and taxi drivers. They also alleged that fresh rules introduced by the central, state and Delhi governments were making working conditions more difficult for transport workers.
In further updates, Soni warned that ignoring transport workers, exploiting them and failing to address their demands could have serious political consequences for the government in the future.
